title: I tried 2 of the best third-party Android weather apps. Here’s the one I’m sticking with
title_bn: আমি সেরা থার্ড পার্টি অ্যান্ড্রয়েড আবহাওয়া অ্যাপ্লিকেশন দুই চেষ্টা. এখানে আমি এক সঙ্গে আটকে আছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Breezy or Gradient? This is the one I'd choose.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityI’ll admit that for the last few years, I’ve been pretty lazy about testing new weather apps. I’ve almost exclusively used a combination of Samsung Weather or Pixel Weather alongside AccuWeather. Ready for something new, I decided to dive into the alternatives. What I was looking for was something that bridged the gap between the two services. That meant something easy to jump into, with a fair amount of customization, and a reputation for accuracy.Ultimately, I found two apps that best fit what I was looking for, even though they took somewhat different approaches: Gradient Weather and Breezy Weather. While they both were a dream to use, neither was perfect, but one of these apps ended up winning me over a tad more than the other.Gradient Weather vs Breezy Weather: Which would you pick?4 votesBreezy Weather is a power user’s dream, with one notable flawMegan Ellis / Android AuthorityThere’s a lot to like about the open-source Breezy Weather app, but its privacy-focused nature and customization options are probably at the top of the list. The app gives you a ton of data metrics to choose from, including common ones like the daily and hourly forecast, as well as options like Visibility, Pressure, Sun, and Moon. You might wonder if too much data will result in a cluttered experience, but thankfully, the UI does a great job here. Not only is it easy to get the hang of — since all central data is pretty much in one spot — but it is also presented in a way that doesn’t feel overwhelming or bloated. Speaking of bloat, there are absolutely no ads, trackers, or other similar privacy offenders found in the Breezy App.
paragraph2: There’s also no premium tier, as the app is 100% free. Breezy Weather does a great job of presenting a lot of information in one place without feeling bloated. Those looking for deeper control over their weather data source will be pleased to find they can choose from options such as NWS, AccuWeather, OpenWeather, and a handful of others. It’s not just data, either. You can even customize Breezy’s appearance with optional icon packs.No matter how good a weather app is, we can’t forget about widgets. Breezy Weather does a great job here, with a clean, minimalist approach that will seem familiar if you’re coming from an app like Pixel Weather. As much as I loved Breezy Weather, nothing is perfect. First, it’s important to note that it doesn’t exist on Google Play. You’ll need to install the app from GitHub or a place like F-Droid. Keep in mind that the F-Droid version only uses freenet standards, while the GitHub version has more weather sources and a few other small differences.Another issue is that there’s no radar. This is largely because there’s no free, open-source radar API that can compete with other weather apps out there right now, and so the app developers feel this is an impractical feature that doesn’t match the open-source nature of the project.
paragraph3: Gradient Weather looks great and has excellent radarJoe Maring / Android AuthorityBreezy Weather isn’t just about providing great customization and a solid UI. At its core, Breezy’s mission is to provide an open-source alternative to the big weather apps. Gradient Weather might not share the same open-source DNA, but it perfectly nails just about everything else.Gradient’s layout is quite a bit different from Breezy, but both are equally clean and easy to parse. You certainly have more glanceable options with Breezy, but Gradient does a good job of showing the most important information and hiding the rest out of the way. Where Gradient edges ahead is in the little finishing touches, like how it uses different colors for alerts, making it easy to know what the alert is for before you even fully read it.Gradient’s alerts are also very detailed, which is nice, as many alternatives (like Pixel Weather) tend to push you to a web browser for more detailed information. It’s not just more detailed alerts, either; Gradient also does a much better job with notifications.While Breezy keeps notifications fairly basic, Gradient goes the other way and can deliver custom notifications based on a wide range of weather conditions. Whether you want a frost alert or a notification that rain is coming, you’ll find an option here. Heck, you can even ask it to send basic alerts every morning so you know what the weather is like without turning to the app or its widgets. Speaking of widgets, Gradient offers a highly customizable experience that might not work the same as Breezy, but I’d argue the widgets are of the same quality.As I already mentioned, I love the idea of radar.
paragraph4: Whether it’s tracking incoming storms or just checking wind speed, I find radar a critical part of a modern weather app. Gradient does all this and so much more from its weather map. It also tracks cloud cover, temperature, and pressure. There’s even the ability to report real-time changes in weather conditions, which can help improve accuracy in your local area.Gradient and Breezy both offer tons of customization options and more; they just take different approaches to get there. Outside of the radar and better customizations, you’ll find a lot of similar features in Gradient that you’d already get from Breezy. Gradient’s proprietary app just takes a different approach. For example, you might not be able to manually change your data sources as you can with Breezy, but at least you’ll rest assured knowing that Gradient combines multiple data sources to improve accuracy rather than relying on a single fixed source.In many ways, I love how Breezy is open source and has a more manual approach to its feature set, but it also means that you have to mess around a lot more to find the right options. Gradient seemed to be a bit easier to “get right” out of the box. The only real downside is that you have to pay money to unlock the full experience.If you don’t want to spend a thing, I’d say Breezy Weather is the better choice here. Ultimately, it comes down to personal preference, though.
paragraph5: Both are great, but Gradient is the one for meJoe Maring / Android AuthorityBreezy Weather is excellent if you can live without radar and want a completely free experience that doesn’t hold features behind a paywall. It’s easy to use, easy to dive into, and, if you don’t mind the sideloading hurdles, a great choice for many.I personally didn’t mind paying the $33 for lifetime access to Gradient Weather in order to enjoy radar and the advanced notifications that Breezy just can’t compete with. There’s also the option to pay $3.50 per month or $22 annually.For me, Gradient’s deeper notifications and radar aren’t just nice; they could make a real difference during storm seasons. This is coming from someone who lives in the rural Midwest and is no stranger to sudden tornadoes or massive thunderstorms.Still, both apps remain great, and considering Breezy is free, it might not hurt to try them both and see for yourself.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.

title: Scam Detection could be coming to Galaxy S27, but there’s also good news for older phones
title_bn: গ্যালাক্সি এস২৭-এ এসক্যাম ডিটেকশন আসতে পারে, কিন্তু পুরোনো ফোনগুলোর জন্যও ভালো খবর আছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: You won't need the latest Samsung phone to get this super useful feature.
paragraph1: C. Scott Brown / Android AuthorityTL;DR Code in One UI 9 Beta 7 indicates Google and Samsung plan to bring Scam Detection to the upcoming Galaxy S27 lineup. The feature could also expand to the Galaxy S25 series, Galaxy Z Fold 7, Galaxy Z Flip 7, and Galaxy Z TriFold. The code also mentions the “s5e9975” (Exynos 2700) alongside a Qualcomm chip, signaling that Samsung may retain its dual-chipset strategy for 2027 flagships. title: Pernia’s Pop-Up Parent IPO: Issue Subscribed 8% On Day 1 Till Now
title_bn: পপ-আপ প্যারেন্ট আইপিওঃ প্রথম দিনেই ৮ শতাংশ সাবস্ক্রাইব
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) got off to a subdued investor on the…
paragraph1: SUMMARYPernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) got off to a subdued investor on the first day of bidding PSL’s IPO will close on September 2 (Wednesday). Post the bidding, the company will list on the exchanges on September 7 (Monday) As of 14:48 IST, investors have cumulatively placed bids for 5.59 Lakh shares against 68.50 Lakh shares on offer, translating to a 8% subscription, as of 13:03 IST Pernia’s Pop Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs’ initial public offering (IPO) got off to a subdued investor on the first day of bidding. As of 14:48 IST, investors have cumulatively placed bids for 5.59 Lakh shares against 68.50 Lakh shares on offer, translating to a 8% subscription, as of 13:03 IST.
paragraph2: The highest number of bids have come from retail investors till now, who have placed bids for 4.85 Lakh shares against the 12.45 Lakh shares earmarked for them. This translates to a 39% subscription of their quota. Following retail investors, non institutional investors (NIIs) have placed bids for 74,126 shares against the 18.68 Lakh shares reserved for them. This translates to a subscription of a mere 4% till now.
paragraph3: Meanwhile, qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) have shown the most muted interest in the issue. This section of investors placed bids for 364 shares against 37.36 Lakh shares reserved, translating to less than 1% subscription. PSL’s IPO will close on September 2 (Wednesday). The company has set a price band of ₹546 to ₹575 per share, valuing the company at ₹4,604 Cr at the upper end of the spectrum. Purple Style Labs’ public consists solely of a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹680 Cr, with no offer for sale component. Post the bidding, the company will list on the exchanges on September 7 (Monday).
paragraph4: A big chunk of the fresh IPO proceeds will be used to fund the lease liabilities of Pernia’s Pop Up Stores’ experience centres, while the remaining corpus will fund sales and marketing expenses till FY30. Founded in 2015 by Abhishek Agarwal, Purple Style Labs operates the multi-brand luxury omnichannel fashion platform Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop. The company claims to sell luxury fashion apparels sourced from 1,109 active designer brands. It sells its products via its own website as well as 12 experience centres. On the financial front, PSL’s consolidated net loss widened 51.5% to ₹285.4 Cr in FY26 compared to ₹188.
paragraph5: 4 Cr incurred in the previous fiscal year. Operating revenue for the fiscal rose nearly 14% to ₹557.8 Cr from ₹489.9 Cr in FY25.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার পপ আপ শপের মূল কোম্পানি পার্পল স্টাইল ল্যাবস প্রথম পাবলিক অফার (আইপিও) নিলামের প্রথম দিনে একটি মৃদু বিনিয়োগকারীকে পেয়েছিল পিএসএল এর আইপিও ২ সেপ্টেম্বর (বুধবার) বন্ধ হবে। নিলামের পরে, কোম্পানিটি ৭ সেপ্টেম্বরে (সোমবার) এক্সচেঞ্জে তালিকাভুক্ত হবে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই প্রকল্পের আওতায়, বেসরকারি বিনিয়োগকারীরা তাদের জন্য সংরক্ষিত ১৮.৬৮ লক্ষ শেয়ারের তুলনায় ৪.৮৫ লক্ষ শেয়ারের জন্য বিড করেছে। এটি তাদের কোটাটির ৩৯% সাবস্ক্রিপশনে অনুবাদ করে। খুচরা বিনিয়োগকারীদের পরে, নন-ইনস্টিটিউশনাল ইনভেস্টররা (এনআইআই) তাদের জন্য 18.68 লক্ষ শেয়ের তুলনায় 74,126 শেয়ারে বিড দিয়েছে। এটি এখন পর্যন্ত মাত্র ৪% সাবস্ক্রাইব করার অনুবাদ করেছে।
bangla_paragraph3: এদিকে, যোগ্য প্রাতিষ্ঠানিক ক্রেতাদের (কিউআইবি) ইস্যুতে সবচেয়ে নীরব আগ্রহ দেখা গেছে। বিনিয়োগকারীদের এই বিভাগটি ৩৬৪ শেয়ারের জন্য দরপত্র জমা দিয়েছে, সংরক্ষিত ৩৭.৩৬ লক্ষ শেয়ারে, যা ১% এরও কম সাবস্ক্রিপশনে অনুবাদ করে। পিএসএল এর আইপিও ২ সেপ্টেম্বর (বুধবার) বন্ধ হবে। সংস্থাটি প্রতি শেয়ার ৫৪৬ থেকে ৫৭৫ টাকার দামের ব্যাণ্ড নির্ধারণ করেছে, যা স্পেকট্রামের উপরের প্রান্তে সংস্থাটিকে ৪,৬০৪ কোটি টাকায় মূল্যায়ন করেছে। পার্পল স্টাইল ল্যাবস পাবলিক কেবলমাত্র ₹ 680 কোটি পর্যন্ত শেয়ারগুলির একটি তাজা ইস্যুর সমন্বয়ে গঠিত, যার সাথে
bangla_paragraph4: নতুন আইপিও থেকে প্রাপ্ত আয়ের একটি বড় অংশ পার্নিয়ার পপ আপ স্টোরগুলির অভিজ্ঞতা কেন্দ্রগুলির লিজ দায়বদ্ধতার জন্য ব্যবহার করা হবে, যখন অবশিষ্ট কর্পাসটি অর্থবছর পর্যন্ত বিক্রয় এবং বিপণনের ব্যয়কে অর্থায়ন করবে। ২০১৫ সালে অভিষেক আগরওয়াল দ্বারা প্রতিষ্ঠিত, পার্পল স্টাইল ল্যাবস মাল্টি-ব্র্যান্ড বিলাসবহুল ওমনিচ্যানেল ফ্যাশন প্ল্যাটফর্ম পার্নিয়া পপ-আপ শপ পরিচালনা করে। সংস্থাটি ১১০৯ টি সক্রিয় ডিজাইনার ব্র্যান্ড থেকে উত্সিত বিলাসিতা ফ্যাশনের পোশাক বিক্রি করার দাবি করে। এটি নিজস্ব ওয়েবসাইটের পাশাপাশি ১২ টি এক্সপেরিওর মাধ্যমে তার পণ্য বিক্রি করে।
bangla_paragraph5: গত অর্থবছরে ৪ কোটি টাকা আয় হয়েছে। অর্থবছরের অপারেটিং রাজস্ব প্রায় ১৪ শতাংশ বেড়ে ৫৫৭.৮ কোটি টাকা হয়েছে।

title: Google Clock is fine, but these 5 features would make it incredible
title_bn: গুগল ক্লক ঠিক আছে, কিন্তু এই ৫টি বৈশিষ্ট্যই এটাকে অবিশ্বাস্য করে তুলবে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google's principal timing and alarm app should draw inspiration from its third-party rivals.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityGoogle Clock might come preinstalled on several Android phones, but it’s not necessarily the best in its class. It’s not a particularly great alarm app, nor does it offer the range of timing features that more specialized apps do. It lurks somewhere in the middle, and its accessibility is the primary reason many use it.However, with just a few minor tweaks and upgrades, Google Clock could easily grow into one of Google’s gems. Looking over the fence at the host of other timing and alarm apps available on the market, here are just a few features I’d love to see Google integrate into its longstanding Clock app.Do you use Google Clock as your alarm app?629 votesAlarm tasks and challengesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityWhen I reviewed a quintet of Google Clock alternatives a few months ago, one standout feature that absolutely must come to the app is alarm tasks and challenges.After using the likes of Chrono and NFC Alarm Clock, I’ve grown used to solving various problems to disable the alarm rather than merely tapping a big stop button. The latter action can be accomplished by a half-sleep Andy pretty easily, whereas I need both brain hemispheres to complete a more complex conundrum.So, what are these “challenges” exactly? Well, taking a page out of Alarmy, NFC Alarm Clock, or Chrono’s books, these tasks could be anything from completing a mathematics problem to a traditional CAPTCHA.Challenges would force users to actively complete a task to disable their alarms.
paragraph2: I’d also like to see options to scan an NFC tag or QR code — both, if stuck on the bathroom door or coffee machine in the kitchen, would encourage me to physically get out of bed to silence my alarm. Then there are sliding puzzles, photo challenges, and physical challenges, like a set of squats or lunges. These are just some of the tasks third-party alarm clocks can perform.As I mentioned, being forced to complete a challenge to dismiss an alarm has helped wake me up every single time I use the app. It wouldn’t be too difficult for Google to integrate; the company could build mirror functionality into Wear OS and Android’s sister platforms, ensuring that no user accidentally dismisses their alarm ever again.More robust alarm fail-safesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityDovetailing with challenges, Google Clock could do with more alarm fail-safes built into the experience. While the app’s audio volume escalation is certainly one of my favorite features, it isn’t enough for truly stubborn sleepers.What would these fail-safes look like? Imagine a maximum-volume vibration mode that triggers after a specified cut-off time? My alarm is set for 7:00 AM, I have a meeting at 7:45 AM, but it’s 7:18 AM, and I’m still sleeping. At 7:20 AM, without any intervention from me, this panic-mode alarm would sound with full sound and fury. This mode could be built to trigger an audio alarm on Wear OS or even call a contact after a specified period as a last-ditch effort to wake the user.
paragraph3: Fail-safes would add another level of security in case the initial alarm doesn't do its job.I certainly don’t see such a mode necessary for use every single morning, but for those odd days when you have to wake up to catch a flight, the morning of check-out at a hotel, and for travelers who may be jetlagged and trying to adjust their schedule, it could be the difference between trouble and triumph.For snooze fiends, a snooze limit would be endlessly useful, while a “Wake up check” — a secondary alarm or notification that triggers 10 minutes or so after the alarm is dismissed — would be a welcome safety net for those who may have accidentally canceled their ringer and drifted off to sleep once again. This check could also be used to confirm that panic mode has been disabled.Better Bedtime Mode integrations and updatesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI’ll admit that there’s a problem with modern Google apps harboring too much bloat, but there is such a thing as good bulk. Bedtime Mode is a great example of a useful addition. It integrates into Google Clock’s alarm feature and triggers various on-device settings that make phone use more hospitable at night and more accommodating in the morning. However, it hasn’t seen any new features in quite a while.Here are some upgrades I’d like to see on Google Clock’s Bedtime Mode: More Sleep sounds: At present, there are only a handful of built-in options available. I’d appreciate brown, pink, and white noise tracks without requiring Spotify or another streaming service. Support for additional integrations: The Upcoming events section, which pulls data from Google Calendar, is infinitely useful for viewing forthcoming events, but Google can certainly pull from more sources. Google Tasks, a weather forecast, and guidance on when to leave home to reach a destination (be it work or the first event of the day) would all enhance this section’s utility.
paragraph4: More control over the Sunrise Alarm: One of Google Clock’s best features is its ability to slowly brighten the screen before the alarm actually sounds, but users have very little control over this process. Offering a few more settings, from the color displayed on the screen to when Sunrise Alarm actually triggers ahead of the audio alarm, would, again, add some welcome utility. A built-in Pomodoro timerAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI use the Pomodoro method to keep my day reliably plodding along. I’m currently using a separate app to keep my work and rest timings in check, but I’m always looking to slim down the number of apps I have installed on my phone. For that reason, I believe Google Clock could do with a built-in Pomodoro timer.This is an entirely selfish wish, but such a feature fits with Google’s overall focus on user wellness. A customizable Pomodoro timer would allow me to adjust work and rest intervals, determine how many sessions I complete before a longer rest, and keep a log of my progress throughout the day.I understand that some Google Clock users might see this as unnecessary bloat, but I believe it’ll benefit a host of Android users who use a separate Pomodoro app on their phones (like me).Customizable presets for timersAndy Walker / Android AuthorityFinally, speaking of timing specific periods, I can’t quite believe that Google Clock’s Timer page still lacks a list of recent and custom presets.I often use the app as a timer for cooking and baking, but each time I do, I have to enter the time manually. Not to sound entitled, this process requires at least three button presses, depending on the amount of time selected.Presets are available as widgets, but aren't accessible through the app itself.
paragraph5: This could easily be reduced to a single tap if Google includes a quartet or more of presets that users can customize and instantly select when required. It’s a simple addition that other clock apps offer and one that would add immense value to a host of Google Clock users. Google Clock is a competent Android app that has the potential to be far better than it currently is. Whether it’s more robust alarm features, richer timing smarts, or more customization options, I’d like to see Google do a little more for this app that millions of Android users rely on daily.If you could improve Google Clock, what feature would you like to see added or refined? Let me know in the comments section below.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.
bangla_paragraph1: জো ম্যারিং / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষগুগল ঘড়ি বেশ কয়েকটি অ্যান্ড্রেড ফোনে প্রি-ইনস্টল করা থাকতে পারে, তবে এটি সর্বদা শ্রেণীর সেরা নয়। এটি বিশেষত দুর্দান্ত অ্যালার্ম অ্যাপ নয়, আরও বিশেষায়িত অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলির মতো সময় নির্ধারণের বৈশিষ্ট্যও সরবরাহ করে না। এটি মাঝখানে কোথাও লুকিয়ে আছে এবং এর অ্যাক্সেসযোগ্যতা এটি ব্যবহারের প্রধান কারণ। যাইহোক, মাত্র কয়েকটি ছোটখাট tweaks এবং আপগ্রেডের সাথে, গুগল ঘড়ির সহজেই গুগলের রত্নগুলির মধ্যে একটিতে পরিণত হতে পারে। বেড়াটির উপর দিয়ে তাকিয়ে o এর হোস্ট
bangla_paragraph2: I’d also like to see options to scan an NFC tag or QR code — both, if stuck on the bathroom door or coffee machine in the kitchen, would encourage me to physically get out of bed to silence my alarm. Then there are sliding puzzles, photo challenges, and physical challenges, like a set of squats or lunges. These are just some of the tasks third-party alarm clocks can perform.As I mentioned, being forced to complete a challenge to dismiss an alarm has helped wake me up every single time I use the app. It wouldn’t be too difficult for Google to integrate; the company could build mirror functionality into Wear OS and Android’s sister platforms, ensuring that no user accidentally dismisses their alarm ever again.More robust alarm fail-safesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityDovetailing with challenges, Google Clock could do with more alarm fail-safes built into the experience. While the app’s audio volume escalation is certainly one of my favorite features, it isn’t enough for truly stubborn sleepers.What would these fail-safes look like? Imagine a maximum-volume vibration mode that triggers after a specified cut-off time? My alarm is set for 7:00 AM, I have a meeting at 7:45 AM, but it’s 7:18 AM, and I’m still sleeping. At 7:20 AM, without any intervention from me, this panic-mode alarm would sound with full sound and fury. This mode could be built to trigger an audio alarm on Wear OS or even call a contact after a specified period as a last-ditch effort to wake the user.
bangla_paragraph3: Fail-safes would add another level of security in case the initial alarm doesn't do its job.I certainly don’t see such a mode necessary for use every single morning, but for those odd days when you have to wake up to catch a flight, the morning of check-out at a hotel, and for travelers who may be jetlagged and trying to adjust their schedule, it could be the difference between trouble and triumph.For snooze fiends, a snooze limit would be endlessly useful, while a “Wake up check” — a secondary alarm or notification that triggers 10 minutes or so after the alarm is dismissed — would be a welcome safety net for those who may have accidentally canceled their ringer and drifted off to sleep once again. This check could also be used to confirm that panic mode has been disabled.Better Bedtime Mode integrations and updatesAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI’ll admit that there’s a problem with modern Google apps harboring too much bloat, but there is such a thing as good bulk. Bedtime Mode is a great example of a useful addition. It integrates into Google Clock’s alarm feature and triggers various on-device settings that make phone use more hospitable at night and more accommodating in the morning. However, it hasn’t seen any new features in quite a while.Here are some upgrades I’d like to see on Google Clock’s Bedtime Mode: More Sleep sounds: At present, there are only a handful of built-in options available. I’d appreciate brown, pink, and white noise tracks without requiring Spotify or another streaming service. Support for additional integrations: The Upcoming events section, which pulls data from Google Calendar, is infinitely useful for viewing forthcoming events, but Google can certainly pull from more sources. Google Tasks, a weather forecast, and guidance on when to leave home to reach a destination (be it work or the first event of the day) would all enhance this section’s utility.
bangla_paragraph4: More control over the Sunrise Alarm: One of Google Clock’s best features is its ability to slowly brighten the screen before the alarm actually sounds, but users have very little control over this process. Offering a few more settings, from the color displayed on the screen to when Sunrise Alarm actually triggers ahead of the audio alarm, would, again, add some welcome utility. A built-in Pomodoro timerAndy Walker / Android AuthorityI use the Pomodoro method to keep my day reliably plodding along. I’m currently using a separate app to keep my work and rest timings in check, but I’m always looking to slim down the number of apps I have installed on my phone. For that reason, I believe Google Clock could do with a built-in Pomodoro timer.This is an entirely selfish wish, but such a feature fits with Google’s overall focus on user wellness. A customizable Pomodoro timer would allow me to adjust work and rest intervals, determine how many sessions I complete before a longer rest, and keep a log of my progress throughout the day.I understand that some Google Clock users might see this as unnecessary bloat, but I believe it’ll benefit a host of Android users who use a separate Pomodoro app on their phones (like me).Customizable presets for timersAndy Walker / Android AuthorityFinally, speaking of timing specific periods, I can’t quite believe that Google Clock’s Timer page still lacks a list of recent and custom presets.I often use the app as a timer for cooking and baking, but each time I do, I have to enter the time manually. Not to sound entitled, this process requires at least three button presses, depending on the amount of time selected.Presets are available as widgets, but aren't accessible through the app itself.
bangla_paragraph5: This could easily be reduced to a single tap if Google includes a quartet or more of presets that users can customize and instantly select when required. It’s a simple addition that other clock apps offer and one that would add immense value to a host of Google Clock users. Google Clock is a competent Android app that has the potential to be far better than it currently is. Whether it’s more robust alarm features, richer timing smarts, or more customization options, I’d like to see Google do a little more for this app that millions of Android users rely on daily.If you could improve Google Clock, what feature would you like to see added or refined? Let me know in the comments section below.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.

title: Man uses robot vacuum to covertly record his wife's affair, wins divorce settlement but gets sentenced to prison for making an illegal recording — Husband lands behind bars after counter-suit over privacy rights
title_bn: স্বামী তার স্ত্রীর সম্পর্ক গোপনে রেকর্ড করতে রোবট ভ্যাকুয়াম ব্যবহার করে, বিবাহ বিচ্ছেদ চুক্তিতে জয়ী হয় কিন্তু অবৈধ রেকর্ডিং করার জন্য কারাদণ্ড পায়  গোপনীয়তার অধিকার নিয়ে প্রতিপক্ষের মামলার পর স্বামী জেলখানার পিছনে পড়ে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: A Taiwanese man sued his wife for having an affair using recordings from a robot vacuum to prove his case. He won, but got sued by the wife for infringing on her personal privacy and was fined the equivalent of 30% of what he earned as compensation p
paragraph1: (Image credit: Getty) In a strange turn of events under Taiwanese law, both parties in a judicial contest lost against each other. A man sued his wife for having an extramarital affair and used footage from a robot vacuum to prove his case. He ultimately won the lawsuit and was awarded a healthy ~$19,000 USD in compensation for emotional distress, but since he secretly recorded his wife, she sued him back for invading her privacy. The courts ruled in her favor, forcing the man to pay a fine equal to 30% of what he'd just earned, along with a sentence of five months in prison.The couple got married in 2021 and used to live with their parents, but they would occasionally spend time in their holiday home. During a vacation in 2023, the man discovered a used toothbrush in their bathroom, sparking suspicion that was confirmed by checking CCTV footage from a parking garage.
paragraph2: In the footage, he saw another person who had driven his wife home before, hypothesizing him as his wife's partner in crime.Three months later, he used a robot vacuum app to try to remotely contact his wife but, upon doing so, stumbled upon something shocking: The footage from the robot vacuum's camera showed his wife changing her clothes, getting in bed with the same person he had previously identified, and walking around the house naked while the other man comfortably sank into their sofa. He recorded the entire thing to use as evidence in a lawsuit that he brought shortly after.Cheating is not a criminal offense under Taiwanese law, but infringing on someone's marital rights can still yield monetary compensation because it's a breach of contract. As such, the man sought a 2 million TWD (Taiwanese dollar), or roughly $63,000, reimbursement from his wife and her new lover. He used the footage from the robot vacuum's camera feed to prove that their relationship expanded far beyond casual friendship and the judges ruled in his favor.
paragraph3: He won 500,000 TWD in compensation, which translates to $19,000. However, the fight was far from over.Since recording someone without their consent is illegal across most parts of the world, including Taiwan, there were grounds for a counter-lawsuit for evidence collection. As such, the wife sued him for recording private, intimate footage of her and argued that the sensors and lights on the robot vacuum cleaner weren't enough to indicate she was being filmed. The man contended that the courts already admitted the footage as evidence, so it wasn't illegal material.However, it was still obtained via illegal means, so the courts rejected his defense on the basis of invading the wife's privacy.
paragraph4: In the hierarchy of constitution, individual rights outweigh marital duties. He was fined 150,000 TWD ($4,700) and sentenced to prison for five months. It won't be unreasonable to say that prison time is a much worse outcome than any amount of compensation paid by the other party. Not to mention having a criminal record on your name can tarnish your civil reputation.Without the smoking gun that was the robot vacuum footage, the marriage lawsuit could've dragged on for much longer, draining the man of his time, energy, and money in place of a swift verdict. Still, the fact that the husband has to go to jail and pay the equivalent of 30% of his payout back to the state as a fine basically negates the financial gain from the marriage lawsuit.

title: WhatsApp ‘Scam Alert’ feature begins beta testing on Android: How it helps block fraudsters
title_bn: অ্যান্ড্রয়েডে হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের স্ক্যাম সতর্কতা বৈশিষ্ট্যটি বেটা টেস্টিং শুরু করেছেঃ এটি কীভাবে জালিয়াতিকারীদের ব্লক করতে সহায়তা করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: WhatsApp has started testing its new Scam Alert feature with select Android beta users. The tool uses on-device machine learning to identify potentially fraudulent messages from unknown contacts.
paragraph1: WhatsApp has started testing its new Scam Alert feature with select Android beta users. The tool uses on-device machine learning to identify potentially fraudulent messages from unknown contacts.Users can block, report or trust flagged chats, while Meta says message content is not automatically shared for detection.(AI Generated )WhatsApp is beginning to roll out an all-new Scam Alert feature to a small number of Android beta users. The tool is built to alert users if messages from unknown contacts exhibit a pattern of behaviours that are common in scams. It uses on-device machine learning, meaning that it doesn't require sending the content of a suspicious message to Meta for analysis.WABetaInfo says the feature is being shown to a select few testers in WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.
paragraph2: 34.1. Meta had previously explained how the technology worked, but the introduction of the feature in the beta version means WhatsApp is getting closer to rolling it out to a wider audience. The official release date has not been announced yet.How WhatsApp scam alert worksScam Alert is an optional feature that users must enable manually. The setting is available to beta users with access under Settings > Account.If activated, an on-device machine learning model analyzes incoming messages from contacts not saved in the user's contact list. Searches for patterns that have been linked to known scam calls.
paragraph3: Whenever a message is flagged as potentially suspicious, it will display a warning in the chat. Only the recipient can see the warning and not the sender.The user is then given the option to continue the conversation or block and report the account. If WhatsApp flags a genuine conversation as spam, they can mark it as trusted. The warning for that conversation will then no longer be displayed in Scam Alert.Meta says scam detection happens on deviceOne of the important modalities in which the feature works is through privacy. The machine learning model is downloaded to the user's device, where the classification is done on the device itself, says Meta.Meta says that the content of the messages doesn't automatically go to WhatsApp, Meta or a third party for scam classification.
paragraph4: Users also will not automatically be alerted to messages when the system provides a warning.If they think a warning was wrong, users can voluntarily send their last five messages to WhatsApp to help improve the system. Based on the patterns seen in scam conversations reported by users, the model has been trained by Meta, according to the company. The on-device feature also enables WhatsApp to add another layer of security without compromising its end-to-end encryption.Why WhatsApp's new scam warning mattersFraudsters often exploit messaging apps for fake offers, investment opportunities, delivery scams, claims to win prizes or impersonation. A warning before users interact with an unknown user might give them one more chance to detect the suspicious action.Currently, Scam Alert is available for only some Android beta testers. WhatsApp hasn't revealed when this feature will be available to all Android users, nor has it indicated whether it will be available on Apple iPhones concurrently.

bangla_paragraph1: হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ নির্বাচিত অ্যান্ড্রয়েড বিটা ব্যবহারকারীদের সাথে তার নতুন স্ক্যাম সতর্কতা বৈশিষ্ট্যটি পরীক্ষা শুরু করেছে। অজানা পরিচিতিগুলির সম্ভাব্য জালিয়াতিপূর্ণ বার্তাগুলি সনাক্ত করতে সরঞ্জামটি ডিভাইসে মেশিন লার্নিং ব্যবহার করে। ব্যবহারকারীরা ফ্ল্যাগযুক্ত চ্যাটগুলি ব্লক, রিপোর্ট বা বিশ্বাস করতে পারে, যখন মেটা বলে যে বার্তার সামগ্রী স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সনাক্তকরণের জন্য ভাগ করা হয় না।
bangla_paragraph2: 34.1. মেটা আগে ব্যাখ্যা করেছিল যে প্রযুক্তিটি কীভাবে কাজ করে, তবে বিটা সংস্করণে বৈশিষ্ট্যটির প্রবর্তনের অর্থ হ'ল হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ এটিকে আরও বিস্তৃত শ্রোতাদের কাছে প্রবর্তন করার কাছাকাছি চলেছে। আনুষ্ঠানিক প্রকাশের তারিখটি এখনও ঘোষণা করা হয়নি। হোয়াটেসঅপ কেলেঙ্কারির সতর্কতা কীভাবে কাজ করবেস্কম সতর্কতা একটি ঐচ্ছিক বৈশিষ্ট্য যা ব্যবহারকারীদের ম্যানুয়ালি সক্ষম করতে হবে। সেটিংস> অ্যাকাউন্টের অধীনে অ্যাক্সেস সহ বিটা ব্যবহারকারীদের জন্য সেটিংস উপলব্ধ। যদি সক্রিয় করা হয় তবে ডিভাইসে একটি মেশিন লার্নিং মডেল কো থেকে আগত বার্তাগুলি বিশ্লেষণ করে।
bangla_paragraph3: যখনই কোনও বার্তা সম্ভাব্য সন্দেহজনক হিসাবে চিহ্নিত করা হয়, এটি চ্যাটে একটি সতর্কতা প্রদর্শন করবে। কেবলমাত্র প্রাপকই সতর্কতাটি দেখতে পারে এবং প্রেরক নয়। ব্যবহারকারীকে তারপরে কথোপকথন চালিয়ে যাওয়ার বা অ্যাকাউন্টটি ব্লক এবং রিপোর্ট করার বিকল্প দেওয়া হয়। যদি হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ কোনও আসল কথোপকাঠাকে স্প্যাম হিসাবে চিহ্নित করে তবে তারা এটিকে বিশ্বাসযোগ্য হিসাবে চিহ্নযুক্ত করতে পারে। সেই কথোপकথনের জন্য সতর্কতা তখন আর প্রদর্শিত হবে না স্ক্যাম সতর্কতা.মেটা বলেছে যে স্ক্যাম সনাক্তকরণ ডিভাইসে ঘটে।
bangla_paragraph4: ব্যবহারকারীরা সিস্টেমটি যখন একটি সতর্কতা প্রদান করে তখন ব্যবহারকারীদের স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে বার্তাগুলি সম্পর্কে সতর্ক করা হবে না। যদি তারা মনে করে যে একটি সতর্কবার্তা ভুল ছিল, ব্যবহারকারীগণ স্বেচ্ছায় তাদের শেষ পাঁচটি বার্তা হোয়াটসঅ্যাপে পাঠাতে পারেন যাতে সিস্টেম উন্নত করতে সহায়তা করতে পারে। ব্যবহারকারীদের দ্বারা রিপোর্ট করা কেলেঙ্কারী কথোপকথনে দেখা নিদর্শনগুলির উপর ভিত্তি করে, মডেলটি মেটা দ্বারা প্রশিক্ষিত হয়েছে, সংস্থা অনুসারে। অন-ডিভাইস বৈশিষ্ট্যটি হোয়াટসঅপকে তার শেষ থেকে শেষ এনক্রিপশনকে আপস না করে আরও একটি স্তর সুরক্ষা যুক্ত করতে সক্ষম করে। কেন হোয়াটেসের নতুন কেলেংকারী যুদ্ধ
bangla_paragraph5: লেখক সম্পর্কেপ্রজ্ঞা সিংহ রায়প্রজ্ঞা ডিজিটাল মিডিয়া এবং কন্টেন্ট লেখার চার বছরেরও বেশি অভিজ্ঞতার সাথে একটি প্রযুক্তি প্রতিবেদক। তিনি সাংবাদিকতায় স্নাতকোত্তর ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন এবং মহাকাশ, স্মার্টফোন, গ্যাজেট, কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা, উদীয়মান প্রযুক্তি এবং প্রযুক্তি দৈনন্দিন জীবনকে রূপান্তরিত করার উপায়গুলি জুড়ে বিস্তৃত গল্পগুলি কভার করেছেন। তিনি জটিল প্রযুক্তি এবং বিজ্ঞান উন্নয়নগুলিকে পরিষ্কার, আকর্ষক এবং পাঠক-বান্ধব গল্পগুলিতে ভেঙে ফেলার দিকে মনোনিবেশ করেন, একটি ধারালো বুদ্ধি সহ।

title: This fan-favorite image editor is the first app to support Android’s new location data controls
title_bn: এই ফ্যান-প্রেমীয় ইমেজ এডিটর হল অ্যান্ড্রয়েডের নতুন অবস্থান তথ্য নিয়ন্ত্রণের জন্য প্রথম অ্যাপ্লিকেশন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: You can now choose to keep or remove location data when using Android's Photo Picker. And here's the first supported app.
paragraph1: Mishaal Rahman / Android AuthorityTL;DR Snapseed is the first app to implement the new location metadata API in Android’s Photo Picker. When you use the Photo Picker to choose an image in Snapseed, it’ll now ask whether you want to include the picture’s location info. This is a welcome move as it gives users greater control over sensitive metadata. Google recently announced a major improvement to Android’s Photo Picker. The photo picker will allow users to choose whether to keep or remove location data in shared images.
paragraph2: It seems like the waiting is over if you really want to try this feature.You’re reading an Authority Insights story. Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.Google has rolled out the Photo Picker’s location metadata API with the August Mainline Android update, and it looks like Snapseed (v4.1.
paragraph3: 5.970833206) has already implemented this functionality. As a result, Snapseed now displays a prompt to include an image’s location info when you choose an image to edit via Android’s Photo Picker. Check out the first screenshot below.We can also see a floating location info toggle in the bottom-right corner of the Photo Picker.
paragraph4: Tapping this button lets you quickly enable or disable access to location metadata, with a crossed-out icon indicating that location data isn’t being shared. I’m guessing this could be useful if you made the wrong choice via the preceding pop-up menu.We’re glad to see the first apps embracing this new API, as it gives users greater control over some sensitive data. Photo editing apps on Android often strip out location data, so the ability to retain this info for specific images is pretty handy. On the other hand, the ability to manually remove location data is extremely useful for sensitive photos.

bangla_paragraph1: মিশাল রহমান / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ টিএল;ডিআর স্ন্যাপসিড হল অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েডের ফটো পিকারে নতুন অবস্থান মেটাডেটা এপিআই বাস্তবায়নের প্রথম অ্যাপ। আপনি যখন স্ন্য্যাপসিডে কোনও চিত্র চয়ন করতে ফটো পিকার ব্যবহার করেন, তখন এটি এখন আপনাকে জিজ্ঞাসা করবে যে আপনি ছবির অবস্থান তথ্য অন্তর্ভুক্ত করতে চান কিনা। এটি একটি স্বাগত পদক্ষেপ কারণ এটি ব্যবহারকারীদের সংবেদনশীল মেটাডাটাতে আরও বেশি নিয়ন্ত্রণ দেয়। গুগল সম্প্রতি অ্যান্ড্রেডের ছবি পিকারের একটি বড় উন্নতি ঘোষণা করেছে। ফটো পিক্সার ব্যবহারকারীদের অবস্থানটি রাখতে বা অপসারণ করতে চান তা চয়ন করার অনুমতি দেবে।
bangla_paragraph2: মনে হচ্ছে আপনি যদি সত্যিই এই বৈশিষ্ট্যটি চেষ্টা করতে চান তবে অপেক্ষা শেষ হয়ে গেছে। আপনি একটি কর্তৃপক্ষের অন্তর্দৃষ্টি গল্প পড়ছেন। কর্তৃপক্ষ অন্তর্দ্রোহ আপনাকে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ দলের সর্বশেষতম একচেটিয়া প্রতিবেদন, অ্যাপ্লিকেশন ট্রিগারডাউন, ফুটো এবং গভীর প্রযুক্তি কভারেজ নিয়ে আসে যা আপনি অন্য কোথাও পাবেন না। গুগল অগাস্ট মেইনলাইন অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড আপডেটের সাথে ফটো পিকার এর অবস্থান মেটাডেটা এপিআই চালু করেছে এবং এটি স্ন্যাপসিড (v4.1.) এর মতো দেখাচ্ছে।
bangla_paragraph3: 5.970833206) ইতিমধ্যে এই কার্যকারিতা বাস্তবায়ন করেছে। ফলস্বরূপ, স্ন্যাপসিড এখন একটি ছবির অবস্থান তথ্য অন্তর্ভুক্ত করার জন্য একটি প্রম্পট প্রদর্শন করে যখন আপনি অ্যান্ড্রয়েডের ফটো পিকারের মাধ্যমে সম্পাদনা করার জন্য কোনও চিত্র নির্বাচন করেন। নীচের প্রথম স্ক্রিনশটটি দেখুন। আমরা ফটো পিকারের নীচের ডানদিকে কোণে একটি ভাসমান অবস্থান তথ্য টগল দেখতে পারি।
bangla_paragraph4: এই বোতামটি আলতো চাপলে আপনি দ্রুত অবস্থান মেটাডেটা অ্যাক্সেস সক্ষম বা নিষ্ক্রিয় করতে পারবেন, একটি ক্রস আউট আইকন সহ যা নির্দেশ করে যে অবস্থান ডেটা ভাগ করা হচ্ছে না। আমি অনুমান করছি যে আপনি পূর্ববর্তী পপ-আপ মেনুতে ভুল পছন্দ করেছেন তবে এটি কার্যকর হতে পারে। আমরা এই নতুন এপিআই গ্রহণকারী প্রথম অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলি দেখে আনন্দিত, কারণ এটি ব্যবহারকারীদের কিছু সংবেদনশীল ডেটার উপর আরও বেশি নিয়ন্ত্রণ দেয়। অ্যান্ড্রয়েডের ফটো এডিটিং অ্যাপ্লিকেশানগুলি প্রায়শই অবস্থান ডেটার অপসারণ করে, তাই নির্দিষ্ট চিত্রগুলির জন্য এই তথ্যটি ধরে রাখার ক্ষমতা বেশ সুবিধাজনক।
bangla_paragraph5: আমাদের সম্প্রদায়ের অংশ হওয়ার জন্য আপনাকে ধন্যবাদ। পোস্ট করার আগে আমাদের মন্তব্য নীতি পড়ুন।

title: I expected to hate the Pixel 11 Pro, but Google proved me wrong
title_bn: আমি পিক্সেল ১১ প্রোকে ঘৃণা করার আশা করছিলাম, কিন্তু গুগল আমাকে ভুল প্রমাণ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: I can finally enjoy the novelty of making calls on my smartphone.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityI wasn’t expecting much from the Pixel 11 Pro. I didn’t plan to buy the phone, let alone love it. In fact, the original idea for this article was to discuss how Google hasn’t earned the right to make small iterations of its phones the way Samsung and Apple have, and that I was going to keep my Pixel 10 Pro.In the end, I changed my mind, and after almost a week with my Pixel 11 Pro, I can say that Google has (barely) done enough this year, and I’m glad I upgraded.Why did I buy the Pixel 11 Pro?Zac Kew-Denniss / Android AuthorityAs I alluded to before, I didn’t plan on buying a Pixel 11 Pro. I loved my time with the 10 Pro, but it had been plagued by issues, mostly related to the outdated modem. There were parts of my town that I never got signal, but my Z Fold 7 or Razr Fold would. It would frequently drop calls and, most of all, get uncomfortably hot. The modem drank battery juice at an alarming rate, too.In the Pixel 11 series, Google has finally upgraded to a new modem. That was the first thing that had me curious, and all of the new camera upgrades and tweaks had my attention. Still, my plan was to wait another year and see how others got on with the phone before upgrading to a Pixel 12 next year.Modems matterJoe Maring / Android AuthorityThe new modem in the Pixel 11 Pro makes me equally happy and angry.
paragraph2: I’m happy that it has addressed almost all of my major problems with the Pixel, and angry that Google waited so damn long to fix them. Fans have been begging Google to change the modem for years, and waiting this long is the bare minimum of effort Google should’ve put into Tensor.It’s early days. Every phone impresses when it’s new, and I know I can’t speak for how the Pixel 11 Pro will age. Even so, the differences I’m seeing in this phone versus my Pixel 10 Pro are impossible to ignore. I have signal everywhere I didn’t before. Over the last week, I’ve purposely driven to parts of my local area where my 10 Pro didn’t get service, and the 11 Pro has maintained a connection in all of them. Clear phone calls over my car’s hands-free system that haven’t dropped out as I drive into a new area, and a strong, reliable 5G data connection are things I’d given up on getting in a Pixel.General performance and battery life will fluctuate as a phone ages, but the ability to maintain signal shouldn’t, and on that metric alone the Pixel 11 Pro has passed every test. Even in more remote areas where all phones have shaky signal, the 11 Pro kept up with my Galaxy Z Fold 7 and didn’t get even remotely warm as it searched for a connection.Adamya Sharma / Android AuthorityEven with how Pixel performance and battery life can fluctuate over time, I’m satisfied with where we’re starting this year. Even at its best, my Pixel 10 Pro would regularly get toasty, especially in apps like Instagram, where it was having to decode so many image and video files. The Pixel 11 Pro doesn’t change temperature at all, at least not to the touch. In fact, this phone has only gotten warm once in my week with it, and that was using wireless Android Auto with GPS navigation.
paragraph3: Every phone I’ve ever used has gotten warm under those conditions, but instead of becoming unbearably hot as the 10 Pro did, the new phone feels like it matches a Galaxy S26 Ultra’s thermal performance.Battery life varies widely from person to person, and I haven’t done any reliable testing to provide endurance numbers. What I can tell you is that it lasts longer than my Pixel 10 Pro ever did, especially when idling. I haven’t had to charge before bed yet, usually going from 8 am to 11 pm with 20% left. I’m hoping that’s something I can still say in six months’ time, but we’ll have to wait and see.The camera features I’ve been waiting for The upgrades made to the camera are more noticeable than I expected. The new telephoto sensor can focus on subjects that are closer to it than before, which makes pictures like the first one possible. Getting a bleary-eyed photo like this on my 10 Pro would’ve meant getting a lot closer to the subject with the primary camera, which would come with the risk of him moving.Camera Looks are everything I wanted them to be. Ever since Apple added Photographic Styles to the iPhone, I’ve been begging for an Android manufacturer to do something similar, and Google has. I’ve set “Vanilla” as my default with some tweaks to darken shadows and add some contrast.Equally as impressive is how fast the cameras are now. Google claims Night Sight is 3x faster, and I believe it. Photos that would usually be blurry from a moving subject are now razor-sharp because the capture is so quick, and the Pixel 11 Pro is even faster at focusing on Bandit despite his dark fur.
paragraph4: The Pixel 10 Pro was already quick to focus, especially compared to Samsung phones that are somehow totally unable to see black cats, but the 11 Pro is even faster. If you take a lot of photos of pets, children, or other frequently moving objects, then the Pixel 11 Pro may be the best phone camera you can buy.The Pixel 11 Pro is great, and the bare minimum Dhruv Bhutani / Android AuthorityI’m not going to gush over this phone without talking about its flaws. The Pixel 11 Pro has impressed me far more than I’d expected, but that doesn’t mean it’s perfect, nor does it mean my initial reservations were unwarranted. When I saw the phone on paper, my immediate thought was that Google hasn’t earned the right to iterate in such small ways. Samsung and Apple make small upgrades each year, but a small improvement to a great phone leads to a greater one. Small upgrades to a mediocre phone only make it less mediocre.Satisfied as I am with the phone and how it does everything I want it to, I still think it should do more at this price. Samsung has adopted silicon-carbon (Si-C) batteries for the Z Fold 8 and Fold 8 Ultra and will likely do the same for the Galaxy S27 series. Motorola is using the technology across the entire Razr lineup this year, too, and both Moto and Samsung offer much faster charging on their phones than the Pixel.Robert Triggs / Android AuthorityWireless charging is especially painful. 25W Qi2.2 on all models instead of just the XL is nice, but Google has done nothing to make older wireless chargers work. The Galaxy S26 Ultra supports Qi2.
paragraph5: 2, but it can also charge at up to 15W on old Qi1 chargers, too. title: Zomato Bans Sale Of Analogue Dishes On Its Platform
title_bn: জোমাতো তার প্ল্যাটফর্মে অ্যানালগ ডিশ বিক্রি নিষিদ্ধ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Amid growing concerns over analogue paneer, Zomato has announced a zero-tolerance policy against the sale of dishes containing analogue dairy…
paragraph1: SUMMARYZomato has announced a zero-tolerance policy against the sale of dishes containing analogue dairy products on its platform This comes as food delivery platforms face increasing scrutiny over food quality, ingredient disclosure and the accuracy of claims made by restaurants and food brands listed on their platforms The company said that, with immediate effect, it has removed dishes that restaurant partners had declared as containing analogue dairy from its platform Amid growing concerns over analogue paneer, Zomato has announced a zero-tolerance policy against the sale of dishes containing analogue dairy products on its platform. It has also warned restaurant partners that non-compliance would result in their delisting. The company said that, with immediate effect, it has removed dishes that restaurant partners had declared as containing analogue dairy from its platform.
paragraph2: Analogue dairy products are substitutes designed to mimic conventional dairy products such as cheese, butter or milk and use vegetable oils, starches and other non-dairy ingredients. Under the new policy, restaurants have been asked to either transition to natural dairy products or remove items containing analogue products from menus if an immediate transition is not feasible. Restaurant partners have also been directed to review product labels and ingredient declarations provided by suppliers to verify the ingredients being used and ensure that food items are accurately represented on Zomato.
paragraph3: “At Zomato, our core mission is better food for more people, and that means safeguarding customer health and upholding clear standards for what’s listed and served by our restaurant partners,” Zomato CEO Aditya Mangla said. The move is aimed at improving transparency and food quality for consumers, Zomato said, adding that the policy is part of its broader push towards healthier food choices and greater disclosure around the food being sold through its platform. The development comes as food delivery platforms face increasing scrutiny over food quality, ingredient disclosure and the accuracy of claims made by restaurants and food brands listed on their platforms.
paragraph4: The crackdown also sheds light on the growing focus of regulators on food quality, hygiene and transparency as online platforms increasingly become a key channel through which consumers purchase food and grocery products. Earlier this month, the Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) suspended the licences of 14 food establishments linked to Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart following a statewide inspection drive that uncovered food safety and hygiene violations. The regulator had inspected 86 dark stores and also issued 60 improvement notices.

title: Online Grocery Startup Satvacart Shuts Down After 12-Year Run
title_bn: ১২ বছরের ব্যবসার পর বন্ধ হয়ে গেল অনলাইন গ্রোসারি স্টার্টআপ স্যাটভাকার্ট
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Gurugram-based online grocery startup Satvacart has shut down after 12 years of operations and disbanded its team after failing to…
paragraph1: SUMMARYGurugram-based online grocery startup Satvacart has shut down after 12 years and disbanded its team, with August 28 marking its final day of operations The startup explored funding, strategic investment, and acquisition opportunities before deciding to wind up operations Founder Rahul H Saxena said talks with two large investors fell through, while acquisition discussions with multiple companies also failed to progress Gurugram-based online grocery startup Satvacart has shut down after 12 years of operations and disbanded its team after failing to secure the capital required to rebuild and scale the business. In a LinkedIn post, cofounder Rahul H Saxena said August 28 was Satvacart’s last day of operations. “The past few years… have been particularly challenging. Capital came in, but largely in small tranches rather than at the scale required to rebuild and grow the business,” Saxena said. The startup explored funding, strategic investment, and acquisition opportunities before deciding to wind up operations.
paragraph2: It was also in discussions with two large investors for a “significant investment”, but neither deal materialised. Satvacart held acquisition talks with multiple companies as well. However, Saxena said its profitability-driven approach meant that the startup did not achieve the scale required to make the deals attractive to potential buyers. “The past few months had become increasingly difficult. There came a point where continuing operations was coming at the cost of the people who had stood by the company,” he added.
paragraph3: Without disclosing his future plans, Saxena said he is looking forward to his “next chapter”. Founded in 2014 by Deepika and Rahul Saxena, Satvacart began as an online grocery delivery startup, offering groceries and other essentials to consumers in Gurugram. It subsequently ventured into quick commerce, offering 10-minute delivery of fruits and vegetables. The startup operated through dark stores in densely populated areas. In 2021, Satvacart said its systems could pick and pack an order of around 23 products within two minutes and deliver it within 10 minutes in a two-kilometre micro-cluster.
paragraph4: Satvacart also claimed that its dark stores were fully digitised and that their inventory remained on suppliers’ books, helping it operate with relatively low working-capital requirements. The startup said it first demonstrated profitability in 2019 and achieved “complete cash break-even” in 2020. However, Saxena’s latest comments indicate that the focus on profitability came at the expense of the scale required to attract larger investments or an acquisition. The startup has raised over $2 Mn to date. Its investors included Palaash Ventures and angels such as Kuldeep Puri, Shailendra Kumar, Siddhartha Garg, Madhu Sudana Rao Kalagarla, and Srinivas Kotta.
paragraph5: Satvacart’s closure comes as India’s online grocery market is increasingly dominated by deep-pocketed quick commerce companies such as Blinkit, Zepto, and Swiggy Instamart, which have spent heavily on dark stores, logistics, customer acquisition, and discounts to expand their networks. Satvacart joins a growing list of Indian startups that have shut down operations in 2026. Last month, social networking platform Medial announced its closure after failing to raise fresh funding amid a cash crunch. Koo cofounder Mayank Bidawatka also shut down his AI-powered photo-sharing startup PicSee after it failed to achieve the scale required to sustain operations. The list also includes quick commerce startup Klydo and online matchmaking platform Juleo.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসারগুরুগ্রাম ভিত্তিক অনলাইন গ্রোসারি স্টার্টআপ স্যাটভাকার্ট ১২ বছর পর বন্ধ হয়ে গেছে এবং ২৮ আগস্ট তার কর্মীদের শেষ দিন হিসাবে চিহ্নিত করেছে। এই স্টার্ট আপটি কার্যক্রম বন্ধ করার সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার আগে তহবিল, কৌশলগত বিনিয়োগ এবং অধিগ্রহণের সুযোগগুলি অনুসন্ধান করেছে। প্রতিষ্ঠাতা রাহুল এইচ সাকসেনা বলেছেন যে দুটি বড় বিনিয়োগকারীর সাথে আলোচনা ব্যর্থ হয়েছে, যখন একাধিক সংস্থার সাথে অধিগ্রহণ আলোচনাও অগ্রগতি পায়নি।
bangla_paragraph2: এটি একটি উল্লেখযোগ্য বিনিয়োগের জন্য দুটি বড় বিনিয়োগকারীর সাথেও আলোচনা চালিয়েছিল, তবে কোনও চুক্তিই বাস্তবায়িত হয়নি। স্যাটভাকার্ট একাধিক সংস্থার সাথে অধিগ্রহণের আলোচনাও করেছিল। তবে সাকসেনা বলেছিলেন যে এর লাভজনকতা-চালিত পদ্ধতির অর্থ এই যে স্টার্টআপটি সম্ভাব্য ক্রেতাদের কাছে চুক্তিগুলি আকর্ষণীয় করার জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় স্কেল অর্জন করেনি। গত কয়েক মাস ক্রমবর্ধমান কঠিন হয়ে উঠেছিল। এমন একটি সময় এসেছিল যখন অব্যাহত অপারেশনগুলি দাঁড়িয়ে থাকা লোকদের ব্যয় হয়ে আসছে।
bangla_paragraph3: সাকসেনা তার ভবিষ্যতের পরিকল্পনা প্রকাশ না করে বলেছিলেন যে তিনি তার "পরবর্তী অধ্যায়ের" অপেক্ষায় আছেন। ২০১৪ সালে দীপিকা এবং রাহুল সাক্সেনা প্রতিষ্ঠিত স্যাটভাকার্ট একটি অনলাইন মুদি সরবরাহ স্টার্টআপ হিসাবে শুরু করেছিলেন, গুরুগ্রামের গ্রাহকদের কাছে মুদি এবং অন্যান্য প্রয়োজনীয় সরবরাহ করেছিলেন। পরে এটি দ্রুত বাণিজ্যে প্রবেশ করে, ফল এবং শাকসব্জির ১০ মিনিটের বিতরণ সরবরাহ করে। স্টার্ট আপটি ঘন জনবহুল অঞ্চলে অন্ধকার দোকানের মাধ্যমে পরিচালিত হয়েছিল। ২০২১ সালে স্যাটবাকার্ট বলেছিল যে এর সিস্টেমগুলি একটি অর্ডার বাছাই এবং প্যাক করতে পারে।
bangla_paragraph4: স্যাটভাকার্ট আরও দাবি করেছিল যে এর অন্ধকার স্টোরগুলি সম্পূর্ণ ডিজিটালাইজড ছিল এবং তাদের জায় সরবরাহকারীদের বইয়ে রয়ে গেছে, এটি তুলনামূলকভাবে কম কার্যকরী মূলধনের প্রয়োজনীয়তার সাথে পরিচালনা করতে সহায়তা করে। স্টার্টআপটি বলেছিল যে এটি প্রথম 2019 সালে লাভজনকতা প্রদর্শন করেছিল এবং 2020 সালে "সম্পূর্ণ নগদ ব্রেক-ইভেন" অর্জন করেছিল। তবে স্যাকসেনার সর্বশেষ মন্তব্যগুলি ইঙ্গিত দেয় যে লাভজনকতার উপর ফোকাস বৃহত্তর বিনিয়োগ বা অধিগ্রহণকে আকর্ষণ করার জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় স্কেলের ব্যয়েই এসেছে। স্টার্টারআপটি 2 মিলিয়ন ডলারেরও বেশি উত্থাপন করেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: স্যাটভাকার্ট  এর বন্ধের সময় ভারতের অনলাইন মুদিবাজার ক্রমবর্ধমানভাবে ব্লিংকিট, জেপ্টো এবং সুইগি ইনস্টামার্টের মতো গভীর পকেটযুক্ত দ্রুত বাণিজ্য সংস্থাগুলির দ্বারা আধিপত্য বিস্তৃত হয়, যা তাদের নেটওয়ার্কগুলি প্রসারিত করার জন্য অন্ধকার স্টোর, লজিস্টিক, গ্রাহক অধিগ্রহণ এবং ছাড়গুলিতে প্রচুর পরিমাণে ব্যয় করেছে। স্যাটবাকার্ট ২০২৬ সালে কার্যক্রম বন্ধ করে দেওয়া ভারতীয় স্টার্টআপগুলির ক্রমবিকাশিত তালিকায় যোগ দেয়। গত মাসে, সামাজিক নেটওয়ার্কিং প্ল্যাটফর্ম মেডিয়াল নগদ সংকটের মধ্যে নতুন তহবিল সংগ্রহ করতে ব্যর্থ হওয়ার পরে তার বন্ধ ঘোষণা করেছিল।

title: Lake Ontario is now ‘Lake America’ on Google Maps, but not for everyone
title_bn: অন্টারিও হ্রদ এখন গুগল ম্যাপে আমেরিকার হ্রদের মত, কিন্তু সবার জন্য নয়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: US citizen will see the "new" name, while Canadians still see "Lake Ontario."
paragraph1: Andy Walker / Android AuthorityTL;DR Google Maps is now starting to call Lake Ontario “Lake America” following recent executive orders. Last week, President Trump signed the executive order to rename the lake officially. Google says the new change is only visible for people in the US, while those in Canada will continue to see “Lake Ontario.” Last week, US President Donald Trump signed executive orders to officially rename Lake Ontario “Lake America,” his second re-christening, so to speak, of a body of water after the Gulf of Mexico.
paragraph2: Following these official orders, Google Maps has started showing the name of the body of water bordering both the US and Canada.In an official announcement, Google noted it will start showing the lake’s new official name, as designated by the US Geographic Names Information System (GNIS). It said the official name change will appear on Google Maps, but only for people in the US.Meanwhile, Canadian citizens will continue to see the old name, Lake Ontario, while users elsewhere will see both names as follows: Lake Ontario (Lake America).
paragraph3: Google also shared a glimpse of what it will look like visually, though you can also check for yourself, as the changes are now live.GooglePresident Trump’s executive orders appear to be a result of the ongoing spat over tariffs between the two nations. In July, the US imposed additional 50% tariffs on a broad range of goods, including electronics, vehicles (and auto parts), and steel, originating from Canada under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930. Canada retaliated with identical tariffs on American goods, calling for “dollar-for-dollar” tariff parity.
paragraph4: Just days after the Canadian Prime Minister announced these levies, Trump ordered the official renaming of Lake Ontario. While doing so, Trump quipped, “We have a gulf, and we have a lake. Now, all we need is an ocean,” suggesting that either the Atlantic or the Pacific Ocean be renamed for the US to have a more complete ensemble.Over the weekend, Trump posted an AI-generated video of him walking up to Lake Ontario, kicking the signage with its name on it, and installing a new one that says “Lake America” on Truth Social.

title: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO: Who is John Ternus and what changes are coming?
title_bn: টিম কুক অ্যাপলের প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা পদ থেকে পদত্যাগ করেছেনঃ জন টার্নাস কে এবং কী কী পরিবর্তন আসছে?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple CEO Tim Cook steps down on 1 September, with John Ternus taking over as CEO. Here's who John Ternus is, why Apple chose him, what Tim Cook will do as executive chairman and how the leadership change could affect Apple's products and strategy.
paragraph1: Apple CEO Tim Cook steps down on 1 September, with John Ternus taking over as CEO. Here's who John Ternus is, why Apple chose him, what Tim Cook will do as executive chairman and how the leadership change could affect Apple's products and strategy.Cook will remain at Apple as executive chairman and is expected to continue handling key government and regulatory relationships.Apple is undergoing one of its biggest leadership changes in recent years. Tim Cook, who has served as the company's CEO since 2011, is stepping down from the role on 1 September. He will be succeeded by John Ternus, Apple's senior vice president of Hardware Engineering.Tim Cook to remain involved with AppleCook is not leaving Apple.
paragraph2: He will become executive chairman and is expected to remain involved in key areas, including Apple's government and regulatory relations. The leadership transition comes just days before Apple's 9 September event, where the company is expected to unveil new products.Cook will step away from Apple's day-to-day operations as executive chairman but is expected to remain involved in areas where his experience and relationships could benefit the company.According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Cook is expected to continue managing Apple's relationships with the White House and the Chinese government. These relationships have become increasingly important as Apple navigates trade policies, regulations and supply-chain challenges.Cook's continued involvement could provide stability during the leadership transition, while Ternus will take charge of Apple's daily operations and have an opportunity to shape the company's future direction.John Ternus becomes Apple's new CEOTernus joined Apple more than 20 years ago and has led its hardware engineering division since 2021.
paragraph3: He has played a key role in the development of several of Apple's flagship products and has become one of the company's most prominent executives.In announcing the transition, Cook described Ternus as a “brilliant engineer and thinker” and praised his attention to detail.Ternus' appointment is significant given his engineering and product development background. While Cook was known for his focus on operations and supply-chain management, Ternus comes from Apple's product and engineering organisation.His appointment could therefore bring a greater emphasis on hardware design, product development and innovation.What could change under Ternus?Bloomberg's Gurman has previously reported that Ternus believes Apple needs a significant design overhaul.
paragraph4: If it is correct, his leadership may lead to real shifts in Apple's product direction in the future.Apple is dealing with rising component costs, supply chain pressures, and competition in the smartphone arena. The company will have to strike a balance between product innovation and its high-end pricing policy, which has contributed to its growth.Cook's exit from the CEO role appears, so far, to be a planned handover rather than a complete break. His ongoing presence provides continuity, and Ternus has a chance to write the next chapter of Apple's history.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life.
paragraph5: She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

paragraph1: SUMMARYNPCI is set to make UPI AutoPay interoperable, allowing users to port mandates across UPI apps and merchants to move them between payment providers The proposed changes could reduce the hold of dominant UPI apps and payment gateways over recurring payments while making it easier for consumers and merchants to switch providers The features are expected to be announced at the Global Fintech Fest in Mumbai next month The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) is reportedly set to make UPI AutoPay interoperable, allowing users to port their existing mandates across UPI apps and merchants to move mandates from one payment provider to another. Under the proposed system, users would be able to shift existing AutoPay mandates to another UPI app instead of cancelling and recreating them for subscriptions, insurance premiums, SIPs, or loan repayments, Mint reported, citing sources. Similarly, merchants switching payment gateways or acquiring banks would be able to move existing mandates to the new provider without requiring customers to register again. Both features are expected to be announced at the Global Fintech Fest in Mumbai next month, as per the report. The change will not alter the bank account linked to a mandate. Recurring payments will continue to be debited from the account originally authorised by the customer.
paragraph2: The interoperability will instead allow eligible mandates to be accessed across UPI apps. Inc42 has reached out to NPCI for a comment on the development. The story will be updated on receiving a response. A cross-app view could also make it easier for users to monitor upcoming debits and identify subscriptions they no longer use. The NPCI launched UPI AutoPay in 2020 to enable recurring payments for services such as subscriptions, insurance premiums, loan repayments, and mutual fund investments. The proposed interoperability could particularly benefit smaller UPI apps such as Navi, FamApp, and Flipkart-backed super.
paragraph3: money, which compete with market leaders PhonePe and Google Pay. For merchants, the change could remove dependence on their existing payment providers. Currently, businesses switching payment gateways can route new customers through the new partner, but mandates created earlier remain with the previous gateway. NPCI and payment gateways have been working on systems that allow merchants to port mandates between acquiring partners, according to the report. The proposed changes come amid strong growth in UPI-based recurring payments. The top 10 banks cumulatively processed nearly 1.
paragraph4: 8 Bn UPI emandate transactions in July 2026, more than three times the 585 Mn transactions processed in the year-ago period, according to NPCI data cited in the report. More UPI Changes Ahead Separately, NPCI is said to be working on a common infrastructure for UPI soundboxes, which could allow merchants to receive payment confirmations through a single device regardless of the UPI app used by a customer. Currently, soundboxes largely operate within individual fintech ecosystems, prompting some merchants to use separate devices from providers such as Paytm, PhonePe, and Google Pay. A common platform could reduce hardware duplication, but may affect the rental income fintech companies earn from these devices. The development comes as the broader UPI ecosystem undergoes changes around merchant payments. Parliament recently cleared a bill enabling the government to introduce MDR on select UPI transactions, potentially opening a new revenue stream for banks and payment companies.
paragraph5: However, the amendment is only an enabling provision and does not itself impose MDR. Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman has said consumers will not be charged for UPI transactions and that any future MDR would apply only to a limited set of merchant payments above a specified threshold. The NPCI-led UPI and Services Steering Committee will determine whether MDR should be introduced and, if so, its scope and structure. UPI processed a record 23.66 Bn transactions worth ₹29.88 Lakh Cr in July 2026.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার ইউপিআই অটোপেয়কে ইন্টারঅপারেশনাল করে তুলতে প্রস্তুত পিসিআই, ইউজারদের ইউপিই অ্যাপ এবং মার্চেন্টদের মধ্যে ম্যান্ডেট পোর্ট করার অনুমতি দেবে যাতে তারা পেমেন্ট প্রদানকারীর মধ্যে স্থানান্তর করতে পারে প্রস্তাবিত পরিবর্তনগুলি পুনরাবৃত্তিমূলক পেমেন্টের উপর আধিপত্য বিস্তৃত ইউপি আই অ্যাপ এবং পেমেন্ট গেটওয়েগুলির আধিପত্য হ্রাস করতে পারে এবং একই সাথে গ্রাহক এবং ব্যবসায়ীদের জন্য সরবরাহকারী পরিবর্তন করা সহজ করে তুলবে।
bangla_paragraph2: ইন্টারঅপারিবিলিটি পরিবর্তে ইউপিআই অ্যাপ্লিকেশন জুড়ে যোগ্যতাসম্পন্ন ম্যান্ডেটগুলি অ্যাক্সেস করার অনুমতি দেবে। ইনক 42 উন্নয়নের বিষয়ে একটি মন্তব্যের জন্য এনপিসিআইয়ের কাছে পৌঁছেছে। প্রতিক্রিয়া পাওয়ার পরে গল্পটি আপডেট করা হবে। ক্রস-অ্যাপ ভিউ ব্যবহারকারীদের জন্য আসন্ন ডেবিটগুলি পর্যবেক্ষণ করা এবং তারা আর ব্যবহার করে না এমন সাবস্ক্রিপশনগুলি সনাক্ত করা সহজ করে তুলতে পারে। এনপিসিবি সাবস্ক্রাইবেশন, বীমা প্রিমিয়াম, loanণ পরিশোধ এবং মিউচুয়াল ফান্ড বিনিয়োগের মতো পরিষেবার জন্য পুনরাবৃত্তিমূলক অর্থ প্রদান সক্ষম করতে ২০২০ সালে ইউপিপি অটোপে চালু করেছিল।
bangla_paragraph3: ন্যাশনাল পেমেন্ট ইন্স্যুরেন্স ইনস্টিটিউট (এনপিসিআই) এবং পেমেন্ট গেটওয়েগুলি এমন একটি সিস্টেমে কাজ করছে যা ব্যবসায়ীদেরকে অধিগ্রহণকারী অংশীদারদের মধ্যে ম্যান্ডেটগুলি পোর্ট করার অনুমতি দেয়। প্রস্তাবিত পরিবর্তনগুলি শক্তিশালী বৃদ্ধির মধ্যে আসে।
bangla_paragraph4: এনপিসিআই-র তথ্য অনুযায়ী, ২০২৬ সালের জুলাই মাসে ইউপিআই-তে ৮ বিলিয়ন এম্যান্ডেট লেনদেন হবে, যা গত বছরের তুলনায় তিনগুণ বেশি। আরও ইউপিই পরিবর্তন আসছে। পৃথকভাবে, এনপিসআই ইউপি আই সাউন্ডবক্সগুলির জন্য একটি সাধারণ অবকাঠামোর উপর কাজ করছে বলে জানা গেছে, যা ব্যবসায়ীদের গ্রাহকের দ্বারা ব্যবহৃত ইউপিआई অ্যাপ নির্বিশেষে একক ডিভাইসের মাধ্যমে অর্থ প্রদানের নিশ্চিতকরণ গ্রহণ করতে সক্ষম করবে। বর্তমানে সাউণ্ডবক্সগুলি বেশিরভাগ ক্ষেত্রেই পৃথক ফিনটেক বাস্তুতন্ত্রের মধ্যে কাজ করে, যা কিছু
bangla_paragraph5: তবে, সংশোধনীটি কেবল একটি সক্ষম বিধান এবং এটি এমডিআর আরোপ করে না। অর্থমন্ত্রী নির্মলা সীতারমন বলেছেন যে ইউপিআই লেনদেনের জন্য গ্রাহকদের চার্জ করা হবে না এবং ভবিষ্যতে কোনও এমডিআর কেবলমাত্র নির্দিষ্ট সীমা অতিক্রম করে সীমিত সংখ্যক বণিকের অর্থ প্রদানের ক্ষেত্রে প্রযোজ্য হবে। এনপিসিআই নেতৃত্বাধীন ইউপিই এবং পরিষেবা পরিচালনা কমিটি সিদ্ধান্ত নেবে যে এমডিএআর চালু করা উচিত কিনা এবং যদি তা হয় তবে এর সুযোগ এবং কাঠামো। ইউপিএ জুলাই ২০২২ সালে ২৯.৮৮ লক্ষ কোটি টাকার রেকর্ড ২৩.৬৬ বিলিয়ন লেনদেনে প্রক্রিয়া করেছে।

title: YOGa Bags ₹20 Cr From Info Edge, Others To Scale Clean-Air Solutions
title_bn: ইন্ফো এজ থেকে ২০ কোটি টাকা যোগ ব্যাগ, পরিচ্ছন্ন বায়ু সমাধানের জন্য অন্যান্য
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Clean tech startup YOGa Clean Air has raised ₹20 Cr (around $2.1 Mn) in its Series A round, in a…
paragraph1: SUMMARYYOGa Clean Air has raised ₹20 Cr in its first external funding round, led by Info Edge Ventures, to scale its clean air systems across India The startup is seeing rising B2B demand from real estate developers and institutions as concerns around indoor air quality grow YOGa plans to use the fresh capital to expand in existing markets, enter new cities, and deploy its clean air solutions on public transport Clean tech startup YOGa Clean Air has raised ₹20 Cr (around $2.1 Mn) in its Series A round, in a mix of primary and secondary deals, led by Info Edge Ventures. The round, which marked the startup’s first external funding, also saw participation from Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal and Three Words Capital. While ₹10 Cr was raised via primary capital, the remaining ₹10 Cr came from secondary transactions. The startup plans to deploy the fresh capital to deepen its presence in existing markets and expand its footprint to new Tier I and tier II cities.
paragraph2: YOGa Clean Air also said that a chunk of the capital will also be utilised to deploy its clean air solutions on public transport and at other outdoor spaces. Speaking with Inc42, YOGa founder and CEO Sachin Panwar said that the startup is eyeing ₹100 Cr in revenue this year. Founded in 2010 by Panwar and formally established as YOGAN Solutions Pvt Ltd in 2019 with cofounders Deepak Raina and Gaurav Nagar, YOGa builds indoor air-quality systems. The startup claims that its systems clean the air across an entire room or building, instead of treating only a limited area like a conventional air purifier. Its Clean Air Bubble system filters outdoor air before bringing it indoors and uses positive air pressure to keep polluted air from entering through doors, gaps and other openings.
paragraph3: The system also monitors and manages carbon dioxide (CO2) levels to keep indoor air fresh. The system can be installed through a small opening in a wall or glass and is designed to maintain positive air pressure across an entire indoor space. YOGa claims that its system can deliver equivalent air quality across a house in about 55 minutes, while using roughly 70 watts of electricity during continuous operation. According to Panwar, YOGa follows a service-led model instead of a one-time hardware sale. The startup added that its systems are already operational across 11 Indian cities and serve around 5,000 families, schools, offices, hospitals and gyms.
paragraph4: It also claims to have undertaken projects for government institutions, including deploying its systems in parts of the Delhi High Court. The startup also claims to have signed projects with real estate players to deploy its solutions. “Earlier, we were mostly doing retail. Now B2B is actually shifting. Orders are coming from large real estate projects and institutions,” Panwar said.
paragraph5: YOGa Clean Air competes with the likes of domestic startups such as Airth, Clairco, Ubreathe and Atovio, which offer indoor air-purification solutions ranging from AC retrofitting to plant-based technology. The fundraise comes as persistent pollution is pushing the demand for indoor air-quality solutions beyond conventional air purifiers. As per reports, India’s air purifier market is projected to become a $1.2 Bn opportunity by 2030.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার ইয়োগা ক্লিন এয়ার তার প্রথম বাহ্যিক তহবিলের রাউন্ডে ২০ কোটি টাকা সংগ্রহ করেছে, ইনফো এজ ভেঞ্চারসের নেতৃত্বে, সারা ভারতে তার পরিষ্কার বায়ু সিস্টেমকে স্কেল করার জন্য। স্টার্টআপটি রিয়েল এস্টেট ডেভেলপার এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলির কাছ থেকে বি 2 বি চাহিদা বাড়ছে।
bangla_paragraph2: YOGA ক্লিন এয়ার আরও বলেছে যে মূলধনের একটি অংশ পাবলিক ট্রান্সপোর্ট এবং অন্যান্য বহিরঙ্গন স্থানে তার পরিষ্কার বায়ু সমাধান স্থাপন করতেও ব্যবহার করা হবে। Inc42 এর সাথে কথা বলার সময়, YOGA এর প্রতিষ্ঠাতা এবং প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা সচিন পানওয়ার বলেছিলেন যে এই বছরের আয়ের জন্য স্টার্টআপটি ₹ 100 কোটি লক্ষ্য করছে। 2010 সালে পানওয়ার দ্বারা প্রতিষ্ঠিত এবং আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে 2019 সালে সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা দীপক রায়না এবং গৌরব নগরের সাথে YOGAN সলিউশন প্রাইভেট লিমিটেড হিসাবে প্রতিষ্ঠিত, YOGa অভ্যন্তরীণ বায়ু মানের সিস্টেম তৈরি করে। স্টার্ট আপ দাবি করে যে এর সিস্টেমগুলি বায়ু পরিষ্কার করে।
bangla_paragraph3: এই সিস্টেমটি অভ্যন্তরীণ বায়ুকে তাজা রাখতে কার্বন ডাই অক্সাইড (সিও 2) স্তরগুলি পর্যবেক্ষণ এবং পরিচালনা করে। সিস্টেমটিকে প্রাচীর বা কাচের একটি ছোট খোলার মাধ্যমে ইনস্টল করা যেতে পারে এবং পুরো অভ্যন্তরীয় স্থানে ইতিবাচক বায়ু চাপ বজায় রাখতে ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে। YOGa দাবি করে যে এর সিস্টেম প্রায় 55 মিনিটের মধ্যে একটি বাড়ির সমতুল্য বায়ুর গুণমান সরবরাহ করতে পারে, যখন অবিচ্ছিন্ন অপারেশনের সময় প্রায় 70 ওয়াট বিদ্যুৎ ব্যবহার করে। পানওয়ারের মতে, YOGa এককালীন হার্ডওয়্যার পরিবর্তে একটি পরিষেবা-নেতৃত্বাধীন মডেল অনুসরণ করে
bangla_paragraph4: তিনি বলেন, "আমরা এই প্রকল্পের জন্য অনেকগুলি প্রকল্পের সাথে কাজ করেছি। এটি সরকারী প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলির জন্য প্রকল্প গ্রহণের দাবিও করেছে, যার মধ্যে দিল্লি হাইকোর্টের অংশগুলিতে তার সিস্টেম স্থাপন করা অন্তর্ভুক্ত। স্টার্টআপটি দাবি করেছে যে এর সমাধানগুলি স্থাপন করার জন্য রিয়েল এস্টেট খেলোয়াড়দের সাথে প্রকল্প স্বাক্ষর করেছে। এর আগে আমরা বেশিরভাগ খুচরা ব্যবসা করছিলাম। এখন বি 2 বি আসলে স্থানান্তরিত হচ্ছে। বড় রিয়েଲ এস্টেটের প্রকল্প এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলি থেকে অর্ডার আসছে", পানওয়ার বলেছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph5: ইওজিএ ক্লিন এয়ার এয়ারথ, ক্লারকো, উব্রথ এবং অটোভিয়ো এর মতো দেশীয় স্টার্টআপগুলির সাথে প্রতিযোগিতা করে, যা এসি রিট্রফাইটিং থেকে উদ্ভিদ ভিত্তিক প্রযুক্তি পর্যন্ত অভ্যন্তরীণ বায়ু বিশুদ্ধকরণের সমাধান সরবরাহ করে। এই তহবিল সংগ্রহের সময় অব্যাহত দূষণ প্রচলিত বায়ু পরিশোধকগুলির বাইরে অভ্যন্তর বায়ু মানের সমাধানের চাহিদাকে ঠেলে দিচ্ছে। প্রতিবেদন অনুসারে, ২০৩০ সালের মধ্যে ভারতের বায়ু শুদ্ধিকরণ বাজারে ১.২ বিলিয়ন ডলারের সুযোগ হওয়ার পূর্বাভাস রয়েছে।

title: Foldable iPhone may get Apple Pencil support; stylus launch could be delayed
title_bn: ভাঁজযোগ্য আইফোন অ্যাপল পেন্সিল সমর্থন পেতে পারে; স্টাইলাস লঞ্চ বিলম্বিত হতে পারে
