paragraph1: SUMMARYMeta’s India and Southeast Asia vice president Sandhya Devanathan has stepped down after more than a decade at the tech giant Her departure comes a little over a year after Meta expanded her responsibilities to include Southeast Asia and amid heightened regulatory scrutiny of its platforms in India Devanathan plans to take a short break before beginning her next professional chapter but did not disclose her next destination Meta’s India and Southeast Asia vice president Sandhya Devanathan has stepped down after more than a decade at the social media giant. In a LinkedIn post, Devanathan said, “After more than a decade at Meta, I’ve made the bittersweet decision to move on to my next adventure.” “After a short break, I’m looking forward to my next exciting chapter — will share more on that soon,” she added. Devanathan did not disclose her next destination.
paragraph2: It is also unclear who will replace her at Meta. Devanathan joined Facebook, now Meta, in 2016 as group director for its ecommerce, travel, and financial services businesses in Southeast Asia. She subsequently served as Facebook Singapore’s MD and business head for Vietnam. In 2020, she took charge of Meta’s gaming vertical in the Asia-Pacific region, which she described on LinkedIn as one of the company’s five largest business verticals.
paragraph3: The company appointed her as its India head and vice president in November 2022, and she assumed the role in January 2023. Meta expanded Devanathan’s responsibilities to include Southeast Asia in June 2025. The company appointed Arun Srinivas as its MD and head for India around the same time, with Srinivas reporting to Devanathan. Before joining Meta, Devanathan spent almost a decade at Citi and more than six years at Standard Chartered Bank.
paragraph4: Since February 2026, she has also served as a founding board member of Reliance Enterprise Intelligence Ltd, the enterprise AI joint venture between Meta and Reliance. She is a board observer at Jio Platforms and a member of the advisory board of the College of Integrative Studies at Singapore Management University. It is not clear if Devanathan will continue in her positions at Reliance Enterprise Intelligence, Jio Platforms, and Singapore Management University following her departure from Meta. Devanathan’s exit comes months after CRED founder Kunal Shah took over as WhatsApp’s global head and stepped away from the fintech unicorn’s day-to-day operations.
paragraph5: Meta also invested $900 Mn (about ₹8,550 Cr) in CRED through a mix of primary and secondary transactions. Her departure also comes at a time when Meta is facing increasing regulatory scrutiny in India, one of its largest markets. Earlier this month, the Centre sought technical changes from the company to tackle child sexual abuse material, deepfakes, and unlabelled AI-generated content across its platforms. Meta subsequently began acting on the government’s concerns following multiple rounds of discussions.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার মেটা'র ভারত ও দক্ষিণ-পূর্ব এশিয়ার সহ-সভাপতি সান্দ্যা দেবানথান এক দশকেরও বেশি সময় ধরে প্রযুক্তি জায়ান্টের দায়িত্ব পালন করার পর পদত্যাগ করেছেন। মেটা দক্ষিণ-প্রাচ্যকে অন্তর্ভুক্ত করার জন্য তার দায়িত্ব সম্প্রসারণের এক বছরেরও কম সময় পর এবং ভারতে তার প্ল্যাটফর্মগুলির উপর নিয়ন্ত্রক নিয়ন্ত্রণাধীনতার মধ্যে সানন্দ্যা দেবনথন তার পরবর্তী পেশাদার অধ্যায় শুরু করার আগে একটি সংক্ষীপ্ত বিরতি নেওয়ার পরিকল্পনা করছেন কিন্তু তার পরবর্তী গন্তব্য স্থান প্রকাশ করেননি।
bangla_paragraph2: মেটাতে কে তার প্রতিস্থাপন করবে তাও অস্পষ্ট। দেবনাথন ২০১৬ সালে দক্ষিণ-পূর্ব এশিয়ার ইকমার্স, ভ্রমণ এবং আর্থিক পরিষেবা ব্যবসায়ের গ্রুপ পরিচালক হিসাবে ফেসবুকে যোগদান করেছিলেন। পরবর্তীতে তিনি ফেসবুক সিঙ্গাপুরের এমডি এবং ভিয়েতনামের ব্যবসায়িক প্রধান হিসাবে দায়িত্ব পালন করেছিলেন। ২০২০ সালে, তিনি এশিয়া-প্যাসিফিক অঞ্চলে মেটা'র গেমিং উল্লম্বের দায়িত্বে ছিলেন, যা তিনি লিঙ্কডইনে কোম্পানির পাঁচটি বৃহত্তম ব্যবসায়ীয় উল্লঙ্ঘনের মধ্যে একটি হিসাবে বর্ণনা করেছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph3: মেটা ২০২২ সালের জুন মাসে দক্ষিণ-পূর্ব এশিয়াকে অন্তর্ভুক্ত করার জন্য দেবনাথনের দায়িত্ব সম্প্রসারণ করে। কোম্পানি একই সময়ে অরুণ শ্রীনিবাসকে তার এমডি এবং ভারতের প্রধান হিসাবে নিয়োগ করে, শ্রীনিভাস দেবনাথেনের কাছে প্রতিবেদন করে। মেটাতে যোগদানের আগে দেবনাথা প্রায় এক দশক সিটিতে এবং স্ট্যান্ডার্ড চার্টার্ড ব্যাংকে ছয় বছরেরও বেশি সময় কাটিয়েছেন।
bangla_paragraph4: ২০২৬ সালের ফেব্রুয়ারি থেকে তিনি মেটা এবং রিলায়েন্সের মধ্যে এন্টারপ্রাইজ এআই যৌথ উদ্যোগ রিলাଏন্স এন্টরপ্রাইজ ইন্টেলিজেন্স লিমিটেডের প্রতিষ্ঠাতা বোর্ড সদস্য হিসাবেও দায়িত্ব পালন করেছেন। তিনি জিও প্ল্যাটফর্মের বোর্ড পর্যবেক্ষক এবং সিঙ্গাপুর ম্যানেজমেন্ট বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের কলেজ অফ ইন্টিগ্রেটিভ স্টাডিজের উপদেষ্টা বোর্ডের সদস্য। মেটা থেকে তার প্রস্থান পরে দেবনাথন রিলায়ন্স এন্টেনার্পাইজ ইন্টিলিজেন্স, জিও প্লেটফর্ম এবং সিংগাপুর পরিচালনা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে তার পদে অব্যাহত রাখবেন কিনা তা স্পষ্ট নয়।
bangla_paragraph5: মেটা এছাড়াও প্রাথমিক এবং গৌণ লেনদেনের মিশ্রণের মাধ্যমে সিআরইডি-তে ৯০০ মিলিয়ন ডলার (প্রায় ৮,৫৫০ কোটি) বিনিয়োগ করেছে। তার প্রস্থান এমন এক সময়েও আসে যখন মেটা তার বৃহত্তম বাজারের একটি ভারতে ক্রমবর্ধমান নিয়ন্ত্রক তদারকির মুখোমুখি হচ্ছে। এই মাসের শুরুতে, কেন্দ্রটি তার প্ল্যাটফর্ম জুড়ে শিশু যৌন নির্যাতন উপাদান, গভীর জালিয়াতি এবং লেবেলবিহীন এআই-উত্পাদিত সামগ্রী মোকাবেলায় সংস্থার কাছ থেকে প্রযুক্তিগত পরিবর্তন চেয়েছিল। মেটা পরে একাধিক রাউন্ডের পরে সরকারের উদ্বেগ নিয়ে কাজ শুরু করে।

title: Activating VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling on your Pixel just got much easier
title_bn: আপনার পিক্সেলের উপর VoLTE এবং Wi-Fi কলিং সক্রিয় করা এখন অনেক সহজ হয়েছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Your settings persist after device reboots too.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityTL;DR Pixel owners can more easily enable VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling, thanks to developer TakaiSaisei’s tweaked Pixel IMS app. The original method of enabling VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling required the original Pixel IMS app and the Shizuku system app. This new approach ditches the Shizuku requirement and also persists across device reboots. One of the biggest problems with using a Pixel phone in an unsupported market is that Google generally doesn’t offer VoLTE or Wi-Fi calling in these countries. Pixel owners have resorted to using workarounds, but a new solution makes life even easier.Korean developer kyujin-cho released the Pixel IMS app back in 2023, which lets you enable VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling on your Pixel in an unsupported market. However, this approach is somewhat complex for newbies, as it also requires you to install and use the Shizuku system tool.
paragraph2: Furthermore, this solution requires you to repeat the process after restarting your phone.Now, we’ve stumbled across a version of the Pixel IMS app by developer TakaiSaisei. The best thing about this version is that it doesn’t require Shizuku at all. And yes, I can confirm that the VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling toggles are now visible and enabled on my Pixel 9 Pro XL. I can also confirm that Wi-Fi calling works, as evident by the “Wi-Fi call” text in the fourth image below. The Vo5G/VoNR toggle is also listed and enabled on my device, although this is presumably useless to me as Pixels don’t support 5G here. The actual setup process is pretty easy too: Sideload the Pixel IMS app from TakaiSaisei’s GitHub page.
paragraph3: Make sure you’re connected to Wi-Fi and that you’ve enabled developer options. Open the app and tap the “Open Wireless Debugging” option. The app will then take you to the relevant option in developer options. Enable the “wireless debugging” option, then click “allow” when asked to allow wireless debugging on your Wi-Fi network. Tap “pair device with pairing code” and then enter the displayed code in the Pixel IMS notification in your notification shade. That’s it, really. You can then choose to enable features like VoLTE calling, 5G calling, Wi-Fi calling, and more.
paragraph4: The app also lets you make cosmetic changes, such as always showing a network type icon (e.g., LTE), showing “4G” instead of “LTE” and more.Best of all, you can enable the “Apply on boot” option so that your desired connectivity settings aren’t lost after a reboot or update. That’s handy, as you previously lost VoLTE and other settings when rebooting your Pixel. Sure enough, my phone’s VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling toggles were still visible and enabled after a reboot, although I had to wait a minute or two. Otherwise, you’ve also got per-SIM controls and the ability to revert to your SIM’s default settings.
paragraph5: I’m glad to see this app being released for Pixel phones, as it’s probably the easiest way to enable these basic yet missing features when using Pixels in unsupported markets. This could be particularly handy if you’ve imported a Pixel or if you’re simply on holiday. Both VoLTE and Wi-Fi calling are also becoming increasingly important options as carriers migrate from 3G infrastructure. But here’s hoping Google works with the GSMA to address this issue.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.

title: Inside Groww’s Revenue Mix: What Comes After Broking
title_bn: ইনসাইড গ্রো'স রেভিনিউ মিক্সঃ ব্রোকারিংয়ের পর কী আসে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: In less than a decade since its launch in 2017, Groww has gone from just a mutual funds app to…
paragraph1: In less than a decade since its launch in 2017, Groww has gone from just a mutual funds app to a super app of sorts when it comes to investment and wealth management. With 1.31 Cr active broking clients and consistently staying profitable, it has built one of India’s largest retail investment ecosystems. Now a listed company with one of the largest consumer bases and a market capitalisation of about ₹1.24 Lakh Cr, or roughly $14 Bn, Groww is no longer the small platform that was taking on the discount broking giants of the world. It is now one of the targets and a benchmark for smaller startups in this space. In FY26, its operating revenue rose 19% to ₹4,644.6 Cr, while net profit increased 14% to ₹2,083 Cr, despite tighter regulations and higher taxes on futures and options. However, Groww’s growth has not yet translated into a financial lead over Zerodha, its closest competitor. While Groww’s active broking clients are nearly twice Zerodha’s 68.47 Lakh, the order was reversed in the latest comparable full-year financials. An FY26 comparison shows the gap is closer but Zerodha is still ahead. Zerodha’s net profit grew 1.2% to ₹4,283 Cr in FY26, while revenue stayed at roughly the FY25 level of ₹8,847 Cr, as per what founder and CEO Nithin Kamath said. Compared to Groww, Zerodha’s revenue is about 1.9 times higher and its profit about 2.1 times larger, against roughly 2.
paragraph2: 3 times on both measures a year earlier. So the gap has narrowed between these two giants because Zerodha’s growth rate has slowed down. Bridging this gap further is now central to Groww’s next phase. However, as it expands across several verticals simultaneously, its growth will depend not merely on launching new products but on turning them into meaningful and scalable revenue streams. In fact, Zerodha is attempting a similar diversification shift, building secured lending, asset management and has filed an application for a merchant banking licence. So Groww’s diversification is a natural consequence of the market, but whether the company does so faster than competitors is the real question. The reported financials from Q1 FY27 provide a clearer picture of where that money is coming from. Consider this: stocks and equity derivatives together accounted for 75.7% of Groww’s total income in Q1 FY26. By Q1 FY27, their combined contribution had fallen to 68.4%. This decline did not reflect a contraction in these businesses, but the faster growth of newer revenue streams. In other words, Groww is gradually reducing its dependence on stockbroking and equity derivatives by adding new sources of income, even as the two core businesses continue to grow in absolute terms. Diversification On The Anvil Brokerage Motilal Oswal expects Groww’s newer businesses to grow faster than broking. A report from January 2026 when the brokerage initiated coverage projected revenue of approximately ₹7,980 Cr by FY28, with broking expected to contribute 67% by then. “We further expect its revenue to double over FY25-28,” the brokerage said in its report. But that’s still an analyst estimate rather than guidance from Groww itself.
paragraph3: This projection also assumes that margin trading, commodities, credit and wealth management will become material contributors over the next two years. But that is yet to be seen in terms of actual absolute revenue volume. Even when we assume that this forecast counts in the revenue diversification, it would seem that the new revenue streams do not carry the weight of this projection. For instance, it implies that broking would contribute 67% of revenue in FY28, which is just marginally below 68.4%, the figure as of Q1 FY27. So the revenue mix is only changing by a shade or two and not very dramatically. Plus, on an annualised basis, the Q1 FY27 operating revenue of ₹1,501.4 Cr comes up to about ₹6,000 Cr, against a projection of ₹7,980 Cr by Motilal Oswal as of FY28. That would require a huge revenue jump and assumes that Groww will outcompete new players which eat away at market share with user acquisition drives. The revenue equation changed very early on for Groww after it received its broking licence in March 2020 and entered stockbroking in June that year. The company turned profitable for the first time in FY21, posting a net profit of ₹2.72 Cr. In October 2021, it raised $251 Mn in a Series E round led by ICONIQ Growth at a valuation of $3 Bn. From there, Groww continued expanding its financial services business. Along the way, Groww merged its US holding company, Groww Inc., with its Bengaluru-based Indian entity, Billionbrains Garage Ventures. The reverse flip aligned the company’s holding structure with its Indian operations and prepared it for a domestic listing.
paragraph4: The move, however, came at a steep cost. Groww recognised a one-time US tax expense of ₹1,339.7 Cr in FY24, pushing it to a net loss of ₹805 Cr despite remaining profitable at the operating level. With the one-time charge behind it, Groww returned to profitability in FY25. Building The Product Stack Between 2020 and 2026, Groww expanded beyond stocks and mutual funds into equity and commodity derivatives, margin trading facility (MTF), intraday and API-based trading, and credit products such as personal loans and loans against securities. It earns brokerage and transaction fees from trading, interest and fees from MTF and credit, and commissions or distribution income from select financial products. Not every experiment worked. Groww discontinued fixed deposits after limited adoption and its earlier US stock-investing product after remittance requirements, withdrawal fees and settlement delays affected the customer experience. It is now preparing to relaunch US stock investing through GIFT City. Two acquisitions along the way took Groww beyond distributing third-party financial products. In 2023, it completed the acquisition of Indiabulls’ AMC business for ₹175.6 Cr, giving it an asset management licence and the ability to manufacture and manage its own mutual fund schemes. The acquisition of Fisdom for ₹961.05 Cr in 2025 added institutional distribution, bank partnerships and wealth-management capabilities. Groww also launched W in June 2025, a wealth-management service for affluent and high-net-worth investors. Then, it piloted MF Prime in January 2026 and rolled it out more widely in July. The service combines an in-house research desk and artificial intelligence to offer personalised mutual fund guidance.
paragraph5: These businesses expanded Groww’s revenue model beyond brokerage. The question, now, is which of these businesses can generate meaningful revenue in the near term and meet the growth expectations of the market. Scaling Products To Revenue The immediate answer is unlikely to be direct mutual fund distribution, which continues primarily to serve as a customer-acquisition, engagement and retention engine. Groww’s asset management company can earn management fees from the mutual funds it manufactures. Similarly, W, Fisdom and potentially MF Prime can generate advisory, management, subscription or distribution income. But these businesses are not yet large enough to drive Groww’s near-term revenue. RECOMMENDED FOR yOU The asset management business could become a key lever. State Street agreed to acquire 23% of Groww AMC for ₹580 Cr in January 2026, valuing the unit at about ₹2,500 Cr despite its losses. Groww also bid for PGIM India’s asset management business in January, which would add scale inorganically. The longer-term case for the business is as a strategic hedge against slow down in F&O or broking. Fisdom and Groww AMC remained small contributors in Q1 FY27, when Groww’s operating revenue stood at ₹1,501.4 Cr. During the Q1 FY27 earnings call, CFO Ishan Bansal said Fisdom had not yet recorded a significant improvement in revenue since the acquisition and remained in a gestation phase. In the preceding quarter, Fisdom and Groww AMC reported operating losses of ₹10.
bangla_paragraph1: ২০১৭ সালে লঞ্চ হওয়ার এক দশকেরও কম সময়ে, গ্রোউ কেবলমাত্র একটি মিউচুয়াল ফান্ড অ্যাপ থেকে বিনিয়োগ এবং সম্পদ পরিচালনার ক্ষেত্রে এক ধরণের সুপার অ্যাপে পরিণত হয়েছে। ১.৩১ কোটি সক্রিয় ব্রোকারিং ক্লায়েন্ট এবং ধারাবাহিকভাবে লাভজনক থাকার সাথে এটি ভারতের বৃহত্তম খুচরা বিনিয়োগের বাস্তুতন্ত্রগুলির মধ্যে একটি তৈরি করেছে। এখন বৃহত্তম ভোক্তা বেসগুলির মধ্যে এবং প্রায় ১.২৪ লক্ষ কোটি টাকা বা প্রায় ১৪ বিলিয়ন ডলার বাজার মূলধন সহ একটি তালিকাভুক্ত সংস্থা, গ্রুউ আর সেই ছোট প্ল্যাটফর্ম নয় যা ডিআইএ গ্রহণ করছিল।
bangla_paragraph2: জেরোডা'র প্রবৃদ্ধি হার ধীর হওয়ায় এই দুই জায়ান্টের মধ্যে ব্যবধানটি হ্রাস পেয়েছে। এই ব্যবধানকে আরও বেশি করে সেতু করা এখন গ্রোডের পরবর্তী পর্যায়ে কেন্দ্রীয়। তবে এটি একযোগে বেশ কয়েকটি উল্লম্ব জুড়ে প্রসারিত হওয়ার সাথে সাথে এর বৃদ্ধি কেবলমাত্র নতুন পণ্য চালু করার উপর নির্ভর করবে না বরং এগুলিকে অর্থবহ এবং স্কেলযোগ্য আয়ের স্রোতে পরিণত করবে। প্রকৃতপক্ষে, জেরোদাহ অনুরূপ বৈচিত্র্য পরিবর্তন করার চেষ্টা করছে, সুরক্ষিত ঋণ প্রদান, সম্পদ পরিচালনা এবং একটি
bangla_paragraph3: এই অনুমানটিও অনুমান করে যে মার্জিন ট্রেডিং, পণ্য, ক্রেডিট এবং সম্পদ পরিচালনা আগামী দুই বছরের মধ্যে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অবদানকারী হয়ে উঠবে। তবে প্রকৃত পরম আয়ের পরিমাণের ক্ষেত্রে এটি এখনও দেখা যায়নি। এমনকি যখন আমরা অনুমান করি যে এই পূর্বাভাসটি আয়ের বৈচিত্র্যের ক্ষেত্রে গণনা করে, তখনও মনে হয় যে নতুন আয়ের প্রবাহগুলি এই অনুমানের ওজন বহন করে না। উদাহরণস্বরূপ, এর অর্থ হ'ল ব্রোকিং ২৮ অর্থবছরে আয়ের 67% অবদান রাখবে, যা মাত্র 68. এর চেয়ে সামান্য কম।
bangla_paragraph4: The move, however, came at a steep cost. Groww recognised a one-time US tax expense of ₹1,339.7 Cr in FY24, pushing it to a net loss of ₹805 Cr despite remaining profitable at the operating level. With the one-time charge behind it, Groww returned to profitability in FY25. Building The Product Stack Between 2020 and 2026, Groww expanded beyond stocks and mutual funds into equity and commodity derivatives, margin trading facility (MTF), intraday and API-based trading, and credit products such as personal loans and loans against securities. It earns brokerage and transaction fees from trading, interest and fees from MTF and credit, and commissions or distribution income from select financial products. Not every experiment worked. Groww discontinued fixed deposits after limited adoption and its earlier US stock-investing product after remittance requirements, withdrawal fees and settlement delays affected the customer experience. It is now preparing to relaunch US stock investing through GIFT City. Two acquisitions along the way took Groww beyond distributing third-party financial products. In 2023, it completed the acquisition of Indiabulls’ AMC business for ₹175.6 Cr, giving it an asset management licence and the ability to manufacture and manage its own mutual fund schemes. The acquisition of Fisdom for ₹961.05 Cr in 2025 added institutional distribution, bank partnerships and wealth-management capabilities. Groww also launched W in June 2025, a wealth-management service for affluent and high-net-worth investors. Then, it piloted MF Prime in January 2026 and rolled it out more widely in July. The service combines an in-house research desk and artificial intelligence to offer personalised mutual fund guidance.
bangla_paragraph5: These businesses expanded Groww’s revenue model beyond brokerage. The question, now, is which of these businesses can generate meaningful revenue in the near term and meet the growth expectations of the market. Scaling Products To Revenue The immediate answer is unlikely to be direct mutual fund distribution, which continues primarily to serve as a customer-acquisition, engagement and retention engine. Groww’s asset management company can earn management fees from the mutual funds it manufactures. Similarly, W, Fisdom and potentially MF Prime can generate advisory, management, subscription or distribution income. But these businesses are not yet large enough to drive Groww’s near-term revenue. State Street agreed to acquire 23% of Groww AMC for ₹580 Cr in January 2026, valuing the unit at about ₹2,500 Cr despite its losses. title_bn: আইফোন ১৮ প্রো সিরিজ থেকে ভাঁজযোগ্য আইফোন আল্ট্রাঃ আগামী মাসে ৬টি অ্যাপল পণ্য প্রত্যাশিত
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple's 9 September event is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with the A20 Pro chip, alongside a foldable iPhone Ultra, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, and new AirPods 5 variants.
paragraph1: Apple's 9 September event is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with the A20 Pro chip, alongside a foldable iPhone Ultra, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, and new AirPods 5 variants.New Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and AirPods 5 models are also reportedly in development.Apple is gearing up for one of its biggest product launches of the year, with the company expected to unveil its next-generation iPhone lineup in September. It is said that the event will be on 9 September at 10 AM PT, with the iPhone 18 Pro series at the heart of it.However, the iPhones may not be the only highlight. In addition to new Apple Watch and AirPods models, Apple is also rumoured to be developing its first foldable iPhone. The details, which have mostly leaked and been reported, indicate plans to make this year's event more than just another iPhone upgrade.iPhone 18 Pro Series could lead the launchThe iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are anticipated to feature some hardware changes.
paragraph2: Both models are rumoured to feature Apple's next-generation A20 Pro chip and a smaller Dynamic Island.There are also rumours of better camera control button functionality and a possible new Dark Cherry colour mode. The iPhone 18 Pro Max could be thicker due to a larger battery.The biggest difference between the two Pro models could remain in the cameras. Rumours now suggest the variable-aperture camera could be limited to the Pro Max. If that's the case, it would be another reason for buyers to opt for the more powerful, higher-priced version.Foldable iPhone could be Apple's biggest surpriseApple is also set to join the foldable smartphone market with its high-end iPhone Ultra. According to the sources, the device might be equipped with a 5.
paragraph3: 3-inch cover display and a 7.7-inch internal display.Two rear cameras and a front-facing camera are also expected to be the features of the foldable iPhone. More importantly, Apple might use Touch ID in lieu of Face ID on the device.It's said that Apple is working on iOS 27 for foldables, including support for side-by-side apps. These reports suggest that software experience may be as significant as hardware experience, if they are true.Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4The new S11 chip and a larger battery with enhanced fitness-tracking features may be added to the Apple Watch Series 12. Apple could also offer a ceramic case option, adding a higher-end positioning to the Watch lineup as a whole.
paragraph4: The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is likely to emphasise performance, fitness and satellite capabilities. There are rumours of other features, such as satellite maps and the ability to send photos via Messages.AirPods 5 may get two variantsBoth of Apple's entry-level AirPods series could also get an update. One version is supposed to include active noise cancellation, and the other will be cheaper, without ANC.What to expect from Apple's September eventThe rumours are correct, and if they are true, then the foldable iPhone may be the biggest news at Apple's event. Sales are likely to be boosted by the iPhone 18 Pro series, but a foldable iPhone would represent a significant strategic shift for Apple.However, Apple has a reputation for holding multiple product launch events. Several of the rumoured updates to Watch and AirPods may be delayed until October rather than announced at the same time as the new iPhones.
paragraph5: About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

title: Ola Electric Launches S1Z Escooter With Bharat Cell LFP Battery
title_bn: ভারত সেল এলএফপি ব্যাটারি সহ এস১জেড স্কুটার চালু করল ওলা ইলেকট্রিক
author: TechPulse
excerpt: EV maker Ola Electric has launched its new S1Z escooter range, powered by the company’s locally developed 46-series lithium iron…
paragraph1: SUMMARYThe launch brings Ola’s locally developed LFP battery technology to the mass-market segment, potentially lowering EV costs and improving affordability The S1Z comes in 3.1 kWh and 5.1 kWh variants with IDC ranges of 179 km and 301 km, respectively, with deliveries starting December 2026 EV maker Ola Electric has launched its new S1Z escooter range, powered by the company’s locally developed 46-series lithium iron phosphate (LFP) Bharat Cell technology, as it targets the mass-market electric two-wheeler segment. The S1Z will be available in two battery variants, with the 3.1 kWh version priced at an introductory ₹79,999 and the 5.1 kWh variant at ₹99,999 (ex-showroom). Deliveries of the 3.
paragraph2: 1 kWh variant are scheduled to begin in December 2026, while those of the 5.1 kWh version will start in March 2027. The 3.1 kWh and 5.1 kWh variants offer an IDC range of up to 179 km and 301 km, respectively. The S1Z is the first scooter range from Ola Electric to feature its 46-series LFP Bharat Cell technology. The battery technology has been developed at Ola Electric’s Battery Innovation Centre and manufactured at its Ola Gigafactory.
paragraph3: In an exchange filing, the EV maker said its in-house cell manufacturing had helped lower battery costs, enabling it to offer LFP technology at more affordable price points. In a post on X, chairman Bhavish Aggarwal said Ola Electric is setting a “new benchmark” as India’s electrification accelerates. “More than just a metal body with a fancy name,” he said, while highlighting the S1Z’s 46-series LFP Bharat Cell. “The industry has always treated affordable scooters as stripped-down products: less range, less technology, more compromise. We’ve done the opposite,” Aggarwal said. Aggarwal said Ola Electric has built the cell, motor, vehicle, software, and “every critical component” in-house and is passing the resulting technological advantage on to customers. The S1Z will run on MoveOS 5 and offer features such as cruise control, regenerative braking, GPS, over-the-air updates, ride statistics, and Easy Park.
paragraph4: It will be available in four colours and come with 12-inch wheels. The S1Z will also be Ola Electric’s first scooter range to be sold through its new dealer-operated stores as the company expands beyond its company-owned retail network. The launch comes as Ola Electric looks to expand its product portfolio and strengthen its position in India’s competitive electric two-wheeler market. It also comes a day before rival Ather Energy is set to launch its new affordable escooter ‘Ather Konarc’. Amid falling sales, Ola Electric is also entering the energy storage segment while shifting to a dealer-led sales and service model. Earlier this month, it launched three battery energy storage systems (BESS) as part of its push into the energy solutions business. The portfolio comprises the second-generation residential Ola Shakti, the industry-focused Shakti Rack, and the utility-scale Mahashakti.
paragraph5: The company also launched the Shakti Solar Charge Controller, which will be available in 3 kW and 6 kW variants from March 2027. On the financial front, Ola Electric’s net loss narrowed 22% YoY to ₹336 Cr in Q1 FY27 from ₹428 Cr a year earlier. Operating revenue fell 45% to ₹455 Cr from ₹828 Cr during the period. Sequentially, loss narrowed from ₹500 Cr in Q4 FY26, while operating revenue rose 72% from ₹265 Cr. Shares of Ola Electric ended today’s trading session 3.5 % higher at ₹38.98 on the BSE.

title: GTA 6: New gameplay video reveals major features ahead of November launch
title_bn: জিটিএ ৬: নভেম্বরের লঞ্চের আগে নতুন গেমপ্লে ভিডিওতে প্রধান বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি প্রকাশ করা হয়েছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: GTA 6's new gameplay video showcases Jason and Lucia exploring Vice City, NPC interactions, a mysterious morality icon, robberies and scuba diving, ahead of its 19 November 2026 PS5 and Xbox release
paragraph1: GTA 6's new gameplay video showcases Jason and Lucia exploring Vice City, NPC interactions, a mysterious morality icon, robberies and scuba diving, ahead of its 19 November 2026 PS5 and Xbox releaseGTA 6 is set to launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026.Rockstar Games has released an extended gameplay video for its highly anticipated open-world title, Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), giving fans their most detailed look yet at the game. The nearly 26-minute video was initially released on Netflix before being made available six hours later on Rockstar’s official YouTube channel and the GTA 6 website.The video was filmed on PlayStation 5 and showcases the game’s open world, missions, combat and the relationship between its two protagonists, Jason and Lucia. It also highlights activities and gameplay elements, including robberies, scuba diving, off-road racing, basketball and interactions with other characters. GTA 6: Jason and Lucia share the spotlightOne of the biggest takeaways from the footage is Lucia’s expanded role. She is a playable character alongside Jason, and players can switch between them, even when they are separated across the map.
paragraph2: The footage shows Jason and Lucia completing missions and travelling through Vice City together. Their relationship appears central to the game’s narrative, with some sequences featuring interactive elements between them.View full ImageGTA 6: New gameplay video reveals major features ahead of November launchGTA 6 introduces new NPC interactionsRockstar appears to have expanded the interaction system seen in Red Dead Redemption 2. Players can interact with people and animals in the environment, including petting dogs.The footage also appears to hint at a morality or honour-style system. A small demon-like icon briefly appears on screen after Jason performs certain actions, although Rockstar has not yet explained what the icon represents.Social media becomes part of Vice CitySocial media seems to be playing a more prominent role in GTA 6 as well.
paragraph3: In one sequence, Lucia is driving dangerously while a man hangs out of the trunk of a stolen car, with an Instagram Live-style comment feed.View full ImageGTA 6: New gameplay video reveals major features ahead of November launchThe feature may only exist in certain missions, but it's representative of how Rockstar has brought modern-day internet culture into the fictional universe of Vice City.More activities and missions revealedThe added footage features car chases, shootouts, robberies and a stakeout in which Jason and Lucia save a wealthy client. The players can also try scuba diving, airboat driving, exercise and off-road driving.There are other aspects of the game that were noticed in the footage, such as interactive cigar smoking, the ability to drink from a refrigerator and a slow-motion aiming mode that identifies a weak point on the enemy.GTA 6 release date and latest leaksGrand Theft Auto VI will be set in Vice City and throughout the state of Leonida. On 19 November 2026, the game will be released on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, according to Rockstar Games.
paragraph4: The official reveal comes shortly after gameplay footage and other material were leaked online. Rockstar described the leak as “heartbreaking” and said it was not how the company would want players to see the game. AFP reports that Rockstar has also secured court orders for data to be made available to them that may aid in identifying individuals responsible for the leaks.The game is expected to be a sequel to GTA V, which was released in 2013 and has since sold over 200 million copies globally.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact.
paragraph5: Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

title: Fintech Startups To Watch: Startups That Caught Our Eye In August
title_bn: ফিনটেক স্টার্টআপগুলি পর্যবেক্ষণ করুনঃ আগস্টে আমাদের দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: With investors continuing to invest money into startups, new products entering the market and public-market activity picking up pace, August…
paragraph1: With investors continuing to invest money into startups, new products entering the market and public-market activity picking up pace, August offered little sign of a slowdown in India’s startup ecosystem. But for fintech, the month provided a clearer picture of where the industry could be headed next. UPI was at the centre of the conversation. The government’s move to create a framework that could allow merchant discount rates (MDR) on select UPI transactions revived a long-running debate over the sustainability of India’s free-to-consumer payments infrastructure. While the final framework is yet to emerge, the Payments Council of India has reiterated that consumers and small merchants will remain protected from any MDR. At the same time, AI is becoming a more fundamental part of financial infrastructure. Razorpay’s launch of Vulcan, an AI foundation model trained on billions of payments, highlighted how fintech companies are looking to use AI for payment success, fraud detection and transaction intelligence. August also showed strong investor interest in specialised fintech businesses. Wealthtech startup Centricity raised ₹280 Cr to expand its technology-led wealth distribution platform, while Navi secured $100 Mn from Prosus in its first institutional funding round. These deals put fintech among the key areas of investor activity in the broader startup ecosystem. Against this backdrop, we bring you the fifth edition of “Five Fintech Startups To Watch”. This edition features startups working across some of fintech’s emerging segments, including wealthtech, investment management and fintech SaaS.
paragraph2: From building AI-led financial products to rethinking how businesses and consumers access financial services, these are the fintech startups that caught our attention in August. Editor’s Note: The list below is not a ranking of any kind. Startups have been listed alphabetically. CoverSure | Simplifying Insurance Tracking Founded in 2023 by Saurabh Vijayvergia, Harshit Jain and Mayank Mishra, CoverSure is an IRDAI-licensed insurtech platform that aims to simplify insurance management through personalised policy analysis, coverage assessments and emergency assistance. The platform acts as a digital vault for users’ health, life and motor insurance policies, bringing them together in a single portfolio. Users can access policy details, manage documents and share policies with family members or advisers. CoverSure’s Coverage Calculator analyses a user’s existing policies to determine whether they are underinsured, over-insured or adequately covered. Its Know Your Policy feature simplifies complex policy language, helping users understand coverage, exclusions and benefits. The feature is designed to help policyholders identify coverage gaps, avoid surprises during claims and make better use of benefits already available to them. Through its Motor Club feature, the platform enables users to manage motor insurance, track challans and PUC status, and access SOS assistance during emergencies. It also identifies insurance benefits bundled with credit and debit cards, helping users discover coverage they may already have but not know about. CoverSure is targeting India’s expanding insurance market, projected to reach $867.
paragraph3: 89 Bn by 2034, growing at an 11% CAGR. Fold Money | Be Aware Of Your Finances For many, the ability to get better at managing one’s money, tracking exactly where funds are going or where to invest, often poses a continuous challenge. Managing finances across multiple bank accounts, credit cards, investments, loans and deposits can make it difficult to get a clear, consolidated view of one’s financial position. Incorporated in June 2022, Fold Money is a Bengaluru-based personal finance platform that was started by the team behind Devfolio, including Akash Nimare, Nishant Verma and Utkarsh Verma. RECOMMENDED FOR yOU Operating under the RBI’s account aggregator framework, Fold connects users’ financial accounts and organises their data. It automatically pulls and categorises transactions from linked bank accounts and credit cards. Backed by Rainmatter and Razorpay, Fold operates in the Indian personal finance software market, estimated to reach $65 Mn in revenue by 2034. While the startup earns revenue by selling subscriptions (up to ₹2,999 per year), it is moving beyond a pure personal-finance tracker to offer financial services. Its current product roadmap includes credit cards, financial accounts and other services, creating opportunities to earn from transactions and financial products. Komplai | AI-Powered Accounting Solutions For MSMEs India’s 6.3 Cr MSMEs employ over 38.9 Cr people and contribute nearly 30% of GDP, yet many operate with lean finance teams and overstretched accountants.
paragraph4: As compliance requirements multiply across GST, TDS, MCA and labour laws, founders are spending more time navigating paperwork and less time focused on growth. For founders Anirudh Varma and Rishi Ayyalasomayajula, this offered a clear whitespace. Founded in 2024, Komplai is a Bengaluru-based AI-native accounting startup that combines AI automation with human accountants to streamline finance operations for growing businesses. The fintech SaaS startup automates bookkeeping, transaction categorisation, reconciliations, ledgers and compliance workflows through its AI system, Larry. Its managed service adds human review, GST and TDS filings, ROC compliance, monthly MIS and financial reporting. Larry also answers finance questions in natural language, allowing founders and CFOs to query live accounting data rather than relying on spreadsheets. Within four months of launch, Komplai has onboarded 15 customers, processed more than 3,500 documents and automatically categorised around 500 transactions. It also claims to have reduced customers’ book-closing time by roughly 90% compared with traditional manual accounting. Komplai is targeting India’s accounting software and outsourced finance market, which is estimated to reach $1.50 Bn by 2034, growing at 8.83% annually. SMEs represented 65% of the market, making them a key addressable customer segment.
paragraph5: Tap Invest | Building A Fixed Income Investment Ecosystem For HNIs For retail investors, the stock market often takes centre stage, with many focused on generating gains from a select set of high-value stocks. Fixed-income investments, however, have traditionally offered fewer options beyond bank deposits and conventional debt products. Corporate debt and alternative fixed-income instruments can also be difficult for individual investors to access, with fragmented discovery, high minimum investment requirements and limited transparency. Tap Invest is targeting this gap by bringing a range of fixed-income opportunities onto a single digital platform. Founded in 2022 by Nishchay Nath, Soumya Kushwaha and Himanshu Chowdhary, Tap Invest gives investors access to products such as asset leasing, invoice discounting, fixed deposits, pre-IPO opportunities and other debt instruments. The startup operates a unified platform built around four products: Ultra: Offers institutional-grade debt investments for investors seeking stable returns and balanced risk beyond traditional FDs. Tap Partners: Provides APIs and integrations that allow advisors, platforms and institutions to offer debt products without building the infrastructure themselves. Tap Capital: Acts as the debt origination arm, sourcing and warehousing debt assets for the wider Tap Invest ecosystem. Bonds: Serves as a retail gateway to bonds and other debt products, with a focus on making bond investing more accessible to first-time investors. Tap Invest has partnered with the SEBI-registered online bonds platform, BondScanner, to simplify access to listed bonds.

title: Lunar Eclipse 2026: Six pro tips to capture blood moon's best shots with a smartphone
title_bn: চন্দ্রগ্রহণ ২০২৬: স্মার্টফোনের সাহায্যে রক্তচাঁদের সেরা ছবি তোলার জন্য ছয়টি পরামর্শ
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Lunar Eclipse 2026: During the ongoing partial lunar eclipse, known as a Blood Moon, smartphone users can capture stunning images by adjusting settings. Check six pro tips here.
paragraph1: Lunar Eclipse 2026: During the ongoing partial lunar eclipse, known as a Blood Moon, smartphone users can capture stunning images by adjusting settings. Check six pro tips here.Cosmic enthusiasts can capture the Earth’s shadow creating a red-orange hue on the Moon’s surface with smartphone.(Pexel)The partial lunar eclipse, also known as a 'Blood Moon', is ongoing and cosmic enthusiasts are wondering how to capture the best shot with their smartphone.
paragraph2: To capture this extraordinary event in which the Earth aligns between the Sun and the Moon, sky gazers just need a phone and a few tips to make the most of it.Cosmic enthusiasts can see the Earth casting a shadow on Moon, turning the lunar surface into a stunning red-orange display. This cosmic event is visible from much of North and South America and parts of Europe and Africa, according to National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).“At maximum eclipse, about 93% of the Moon's diameter will be inside Earth's dark central shadow, called the umbra.
paragraph3: The Moon will not be completely covered, but it can look dramatically darkened, with a rusty, coppery tint along the covered edge,” the space agency said.Given below are the timings in UTC for the lunar eclipse which change with time zone:Penumbral eclipse begins: 01:24 UTCPartial lunar eclipse begins: 03:34 UTCGreatest eclipse: 04:13 UTCPartial ends: 05:52 UTCPenumbral ends: 07:02 UTCHow to use phone's camera modes to get clearer pictureTo capture a memorable picture of the celestial event, change phone's auto settings to 'night mode' or 'astrophotography mode'. If this feature isn't available, select manual or 'pro' mode and change the exposure time, ISO, white balance and other settings.How to avoid moontrailingThere is no need to worry about sturdy shots even in the absence of tripod as simple hack can solve the problem.
paragraph4: The tip is to prop smartphone up against a wall or any other stable object, so that the device is steady when capturing magnificent shots.How to capture magnified shotsWith the help of a telescope or a pair of binoculars one can capture magnified shots of the lunar eclipse. Attempt ‘afocal photography’ by placing phone's camera down the eyepiece. Although this is tricky, but a smartphone telescope adapter will give best results.
paragraph5: How to set camera's focus on moonOnce the Moon is centred in smartphone's screen, tap on it and select lock the focus option.How to change exposure and ISO for best shotMany a times the Moon ends up looking like a featureless white blob when captured with smartphones because of its over-exposure. To address this issue, low ISO must be set when the moon is bright and vice versa when the Moon is dim during totalityWill zoom in feature give better resultsNo, zoom in feature will not give better results as it can distort pixels. The best move is to capture the image without zoom even if the moon looks tiny and then crop and zoom later on computer using picture-editing software like Photoshop or GIMP.
bangla_paragraph1: চন্দ্রগ্রহণ ২০২৬: রক্ত চাঁদ নামে পরিচিত চলমান আংশিক চন্দ্র গ্রহণের সময়, স্মার্টফোন ব্যবহারকারীরা সেটিংস সামঞ্জস্য করে অত্যাশ্চর্য চিত্র ক্যাপচার করতে পারেন। এখানে ছয়টি প্রো টিপস দেখুন। মহাজাগতিক উত্সাহীরা স্মার্টফোনে চাঁদের পৃষ্ঠে লাল-অরেঞ্জ রঙ তৈরি করে পৃথিবীর ছায়া ক্যাপচারে নিতে পারেন।
bangla_paragraph2: To capture this extraordinary event in which the Earth aligns between the Sun and the Moon, sky gazers just need a phone and a few tips to make the most of it.Cosmic enthusiasts can see the Earth casting a shadow on Moon, turning the lunar surface into a stunning red-orange display. This cosmic event is visible from much of North and South America and parts of Europe and Africa, according to National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).“At maximum eclipse, about 93% of the Moon's diameter will be inside Earth's dark central shadow, called the umbra.
bangla_paragraph3: The Moon will not be completely covered, but it can look dramatically darkened, with a rusty, coppery tint along the covered edge,” the space agency said.Given below are the timings in UTC for the lunar eclipse which change with time zone:Penumbral eclipse begins: 01:24 UTCPartial lunar eclipse begins: 03:34 UTCGreatest eclipse: 04:13 UTCPartial ends: 05:52 UTCPenumbral ends: 07:02 UTCHow to use phone's camera modes to get clearer pictureTo capture a memorable picture of the celestial event, change phone's auto settings to 'night mode' or 'astrophotography mode'. If this feature isn't available, select manual or 'pro' mode and change the exposure time, ISO, white balance and other settings.How to avoid moontrailingThere is no need to worry about sturdy shots even in the absence of tripod as simple hack can solve the problem.
bangla_paragraph4: The tip is to prop smartphone up against a wall or any other stable object, so that the device is steady when capturing magnificent shots.How to capture magnified shotsWith the help of a telescope or a pair of binoculars one can capture magnified shots of the lunar eclipse. Attempt ‘afocal photography’ by placing phone's camera down the eyepiece. Although this is tricky, but a smartphone telescope adapter will give best results.
bangla_paragraph5: How to set camera's focus on moonOnce the Moon is centred in smartphone's screen, tap on it and select lock the focus option.How to change exposure and ISO for best shotMany a times the Moon ends up looking like a featureless white blob when captured with smartphones because of its over-exposure. To address this issue, low ISO must be set when the moon is bright and vice versa when the Moon is dim during totalityWill zoom in feature give better resultsNo, zoom in feature will not give better results as it can distort pixels. The best move is to capture the image without zoom even if the moon looks tiny and then crop and zoom later on computer using picture-editing software like Photoshop or GIMP.

title: 'AI job disruption inevitable, but tech will be net job creator': NVIDIAs Jensen Huang contradicts Bill Gates
title_bn: 'এআই কর্মসংস্থান বিঘ্ন অনিবার্য, কিন্তু প্রযুক্তি নেট কর্মসংস্থানের স্রষ্টা হবে': এনভিআইডিআইএ'র জেন্সন হুয়াং বিল গেটসের সাথে দ্বিমত পোষণ করেছেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has disagreed with Bill Gates' views on AI-driven job losses, saying that while "everybody's jobs will be changed because of AI," the technology will ultimately be a "net job creator."
paragraph1: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has disagreed with Bill Gates' views on AI-driven job losses, saying that while "everybody's jobs will be changed because of AI," the technology will ultimately be a "net job creator."'AI job disruption inevitable, but tech will be net job creator': NVIDIAs Jensen Huang contradicts Bill GatesNew Delhi [India], August 28 (ANI): NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has disagreed with Bill Gates' views on AI-driven job losses, saying that while "everybody's jobs will be changed because of AI," the technology will ultimately be a "net job creator."In an interview with FOX Business, Huang said AI would change jobs across industries, with some roles being eliminated while many new ones are created. This comes after Bill Gates raised concerns over the impact of artificial intelligence, warning in a new essay that the technology could rapidly reshape the US labour market and put millions of jobs at risk."Everybody's jobs will be changed because of AI.
paragraph2: My job has changed. And some jobs will be eliminated, many new jobs will be created," he said. Further, referring to the impact of technological advances in the past, Huang said, "I believe again that this will be a net job creator."However, he acknowledged that many jobs would be disrupted by AI and said society needed to be "sensible," "sensitive" and "supportive" in addressing the impact.Meanwhile, Huang argued that greater productivity would not necessarily lead companies to cut jobs.
paragraph3: Instead, he said, more productive and profitable companies would be able to invest in growth and hire more people."When companies are more productive, they don't lay off people, they hire more people...the reason for that is because companies have ambitions, most companies do, and I would say the vast majority of the world's companies do," he said.Huang also highlighted that AI has become commercially useful, with AI companies seeing strong demand for their services. However, he said compute capacity is now the main constraint on AI growth."
paragraph4: AI has become useful. It's doing productive work and it's doing productive tasks and the tokens that these AI labs are generating are profitable tokens. And when you're generating something profitable and the demand is so extraordinary, you want to generate more of it. So the thing that's limiting their growth today is not customers, is not their technology, customers are the demand is incredible, what's holding it back now is just compute."Huang has called for more computing capacity to support the growth of AI labs.
paragraph5: He also highlighted the broader adoption of AI beyond leading AI labs, saying the technology is increasingly being used by enterprises and across sovereign and cloud AI platforms worldwide.Commenting on its advanced AI computing platform Vera Rubin, he said, "This is going to be the fastest product launch we've ever had in history....Rubin is going to be even faster...So it's going to be a huge year next year."
bangla_paragraph1: এনভিআইডিআইএর প্রধান নির্বাহী জেন্সন হুয়াং এআই-চালিত চাকরির ক্ষতির বিষয়ে বিল গেটসের মতামতের সাথে একমত নন, তিনি বলেছেন যে যদিও "এআই-নির্ভর কাজের কারণে প্রত্যেকের চাকরি বদলে যাবে", প্রযুক্তি শেষ পর্যন্ত "নেট কাজের স্রষ্টা" হবে।
bangla_paragraph2: আমার কাজ বদলে গেছে। এবং কিছু চাকরি মুছে ফেলা হবে, অনেক নতুন চাকরি তৈরি হবে", তিনি বলেন। অতীতে প্রযুক্তিগত অগ্রগতির প্রভাবের কথা উল্লেখ করে হুয়াং বলেন, "আমি আবারও বিশ্বাস করি যে এটি একটি নেট কর্মসংস্থান সৃষ্টিকারী হবে।"তবে, তিনি স্বীকার করেছেন যে অনেক কর্মসংস্থানের ক্ষেত্রে এআই দ্বারা ব্যাঘাত ঘটবে এবং বলেছেন যে সমাজকে প্রভাব মোকাবেলায় "বুদ্ধিমান", "সংবেদনশীল" এবং "সমর্থনশীল" হতে হবে।
bangla_paragraph3: পরিবর্তে, তিনি বলেন, আরও উৎপাদনশীল এবং লাভজনক কোম্পানিগুলি বৃদ্ধির জন্য বিনিয়োগ করতে এবং আরও বেশি লোক নিয়োগ করতে সক্ষম হবে। "যখন কোম্পানিগুলো আরো উৎপাদনশীল হয়, তারা মানুষকে ছাঁটাই করে না, তারা আরো লোক নিয়োদন করে... এর কারণ হল যে কোম্পানিগুলির উচ্চাকাঙ্ক্ষা রয়েছে, বেশিরভাগ কোম্পানি আছে, এবং আমি বলব বিশ্বের বেশিরভাগ কোম্পানী আছে", তিনি বলেন। হুয়াং আরও উল্লেখ করেছেন যে এআই বাণিজ্যিকভাবে দরকারী হয়ে উঠেছে, এআই কোম্পানিগুলোর তাদের পরিষেবার জন্য শক্তিশালী চাহিদা দেখা যাচ্ছে। তবে তিনি বলেন যে কম্পিউটারের ক্যাপ
bangla_paragraph4: এআই দরকারী হয়ে উঠেছে। এটি উত্পাদনশীল কাজ করছে এবং এটি উত্সাহী কাজ করছে, এবং এই এআই ল্যাবগুলি যে টোকেনগুলি তৈরি করছে তা লাভজনক টোকেনের মতো। এবং যখন আপনি লাভজনক কিছু তৈরি করছেন এবং চাহিদা এত অসাধারণ, আপনি এটি আরও উত্পন্ন করতে চান। সুতরাং আজ তাদের বৃদ্ধি সীমাবদ্ধ করে এমন জিনিসটি গ্রাহক নয়, তাদের প্রযুক্তি নয়, গ্রাহকরা চাহিদার অবিশ্বাস্য, যা এখন এটিকে আটকে রেখেছে তা কেবল কম্পিউটিং।"হুয়াং আরও বেশি কম্পিউটিং ক্ষমতা সমর্থন করার আহ্বান জানিয়েছেন।
bangla_paragraph5: তিনি এআই ল্যাবের বাইরে এআই এর ব্যাপক গ্রহণের কথাও তুলে ধরেন। তিনি বলেন, এআই প্রযুক্তি বিশ্বব্যাপী বিভিন্ন উদ্যোগ এবং সার্বভৌম এবং ক্লাউড এআই প্ল্যাটফর্মের মাধ্যমে ক্রমবর্ধমানভাবে ব্যবহার করা হচ্ছে। এআই কম্পিউটিং প্ল্যাটଫর্ম ভেরা রুবিনের বিষয়ে তিনি বলেন",এটি হবে ইতিহাসের সবচেয়ে দ্রুত পণ্য লঞ্চ। রুবিনে আরও দ্রুত হবে। সুতরাং আগামী বছর এটি একটি বিশাল বছর হবে।

paragraph1: Edgar Cervantes / Android AuthorityTL;DR OpenAI has confirmed that ChatGPT is experiencing issues. The company warns that Workspace Agents and ChatGPT Work users may see elevated error rates on web and mobile. A fix is currently being worked on. bangla_paragraph1: এডগার সার্ভেন্টেস / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষটিএল;ডিআর ওপেনএআই নিশ্চিত করেছে যে চ্যাটজিপিটি সমস্যাগুলির সম্মুখীন হচ্ছে। সংস্থাটি সতর্ক করে দিয়েছে যে ওয়ার্কস্পেস এজেন্ট এবং চ্যাট জিপিটি ওয়ার্ক ব্যবহারকারীরা ওয়েব এবং মোবাইলের ক্ষেত্রে বর্ধিত ত্রুটির হার দেখতে পারেন। একটি ফিক্সের জন্য বর্তমানে কাজ করা হচ্ছে। আপডেট, আগস্ট 27, 2026 (10:30 PM ET): ওপেনএইআই নিশ্চিত করেছেন যে চটজিপিটির পরিষেবাগুলি পুনরুদ্ধার করা হয়েছে এবং চট জিপিটির ওয়ার্কসপেস এবং ওয়ার্কস্পেস এজেন্টেস 06:14 PM ET থেকে স্বাভাবিকভাবে কাজ করছে।
bangla_paragraph2: মূল নিবন্ধ, ২৭ আগস্ট, ২০২৬ (২ঃ৪৬ বিকেলে ইটি): আপনি যদি আজ চ্যাটজিপিটি নিয়ে সমস্যায় পড়েন তবে এটি আপনার পক্ষে সমস্যা নয়। এমন অনেক লোক রয়েছে যাদের অনুরূপ সমস্যা রয়েছে। চ্যাটবট বর্তমানে সমস্যাগুলির সম্মুখীন হচ্ছে। ওপেনএআই তার স্থিতি ওয়েবসাইটে বলেছে যে চলমান পরিষেবা বাধা রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: বিশেষত, ওয়ার্কস্পেস এজেন্ট এবং চ্যাটজিপিটি ওয়ার্কের ব্যবহারকারীরা বর্ধিত ত্রুটির হারে চলছে। সমস্যাগুলি চ্যাট জিপিটির ওয়েব এবং মোবাইল উভয় সংস্করণকেই প্রভাবিত করে। যদিও সংস্থাটি সমস্যাটি স্বীকার করেছে, তবে এটি কত তাড়াতাড়ি সমাধান আসবে তা পরিষ্কার নয়। ওপেনএআই বলেছে যে এটি বর্তমানে একটি প্রশমন বাস্তবায়নে কাজ করছে।
bangla_paragraph4: আমরা পরিস্থিতির উপর নজর রাখব। একবার চ্যাটজিপিটি আবার অনলাইনে এলে, আমরা এই নিবন্ধটি নতুন খবর দিয়ে আপডেট করব। অনুসরণ করুনআমাদের সম্প্রদায়ের অংশ হওয়ার জন্য আপনাকে ধন্যবাদ। পোস্ট করার আগে আমাদের মন্তব্য নীতি পড়ুন।

title: This repairable Android phone just won over almost everyone
title_bn: এই মেরামতযোগ্য অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ফোনটি প্রায় সবাইকে জয় করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: On its US release, we ran a poll asking whether you liked the new Fairphone Gen 6 Plus. You gave us a resounding answer.
paragraph1: Paul Jones / Android AuthorityThe Samsung Galaxy S5 still has a special place in my heart, purely because I could pop the back off and swap in a fresh battery myself. Phones have come a long way since then, and that kind of easy repairability largely disappeared along the way. But Fairphone has spent years trying to keep the idea alive, and its latest phone brings that philosophy to the US more directly than ever.The Fairphone Gen 6 Plus is the first model the company is selling directly in the US — rather than through Murena — and it runs the standard Google-equipped version of Android. It costs $649 and lets you replace up to 12 components with a single screwdriver, including the battery, display, cameras, and USB-C port. The upgrades over the regular Gen 6 are fairly modest, but we still wanted to know what you made of the package.
paragraph2: We asked our readers whether the Gen 6 Plus was hot in a recent poll, and the results could hardly have been more definitive. Take a look for yourself. There wasn’t much suspense once the votes were counted. Of more than 1,500 responses, 91.5% said the Fairphone Gen 6 Plus was hot. Only 8.
paragraph3: 5% went the other way, making this one of the more decisive poll results we’ve seen in a while.Even in an article that Fairphone fans might be more likely to read, that’s an impressive reception, especially since the Gen 6 Plus isn’t pushing the bigger brands hard on specs. At $649, you can find plenty of Android phones with more powerful hardware, and the upgrades over the regular Fairphone Gen 6 aren’t dramatic. What you’re paying for is a phone designed to be kept and repaired rather than replaced when one component starts giving you trouble.In an article about the phone’s predecessor at the start of the year, a poll on what might tempt people away from the biggest smartphone brands named repairability the second-most popular reason. As such, maybe we shouldn’t be so surprised by this result.
paragraph4: Plus, the Gen 6 Plus also removes one of Fairphone’s previous hurdles in the US by being sold directly by the company with Google’s usual apps and services onboard. In hindsight, what’s not to like?Despite the poll’s overwhelming outcome, there were a few reservations in the comments section of our previous article. Reader Dooglehead liked the repairable idea but called the missing headphone jack “a deal breaker,” with Changhaitravis agreeing that “if only it had a 3.5mm headphone jack and FM radio built in, i woulda bought one near instantly.”In fairness to the bigger players, Kameljoe21 argued that modern phones already last long enough that replaceable parts are solving a problem most people won’t have.
paragraph5: For a balanced view, Secureopensource was coming from direct experience, saying, “I love the idea of the fairphone, I’m using one to send this comment,” but didn’t feel the Gen 6 hardware had addressed longstanding issues well enough to justify paying the premium again.Fairphone Gen 6 PlusFairphone Gen 6 PlusRepairable • Long update policy • Expandable storageMSRP: $649.00An easily repairable phone with updates to 2033The Fairphone Gen 6 Plus brings a repairable design, allowing you to remove up to 12 parts with one screwdriver. Expect years of software updates as well, with at least six OS upgrades.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.
bangla_paragraph1: পল জোন্স / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষস্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি এস 5 এখনও আমার হৃদয়ে একটি বিশেষ জায়গা রয়েছে, কেবলমাত্র কারণ আমি পিছনটি বন্ধ করে নতুন ব্যাটারিটি নিজেরাই প্রতিস্থাপন করতে পারি। ফোনগুলি তখন থেকে অনেক দূর চলে গেছে, এবং সেই ধরণের সহজ মেরামতযোগ্যতা বেশিরভাগ পথেই অদৃশ্য হয়ে গেছে। তবে ফেয়ারফোন এই ধারণাটি বাঁচিয়ে রাখার চেষ্টা করে বহু বছর কাটিয়ে দিয়েছে এবং এর সর্বশেষ ফোনটি মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে আগের চেয়ে আরও সরাসরি এই দর্শনটি নিয়ে আসে। ফেয়ারফোন জেনারেল 6 প্লাস হ'ল প্রথম মডেল যা সংস্থাটি সরাসরি
bangla_paragraph2: আমরা আমাদের পাঠকদের জিজ্ঞাসা করেছি যে সম্প্রতি একটি জরিপে জেনার 6 প্লাসটি গরম ছিল কিনা, এবং ফলাফলগুলি আরও স্পষ্ট হতে পারে না। নিজের জন্য দেখুন। ভোট গণনা করার পরে খুব বেশি সানসেন্স ছিল না। 1,500 এরও বেশি প্রতিক্রিয়াগুলির মধ্যে 91.5% বলেছেন যে ফেয়ারফোন জেনারেটর 6 প্লাস গরম। মাত্র 8.
bangla_paragraph3: ৫% অন্য দিকে গিয়েছিল, এটিকে আমরা কিছু সময়ের মধ্যে দেখেছি এমন একটি আরও সিদ্ধান্তমূলক জরিপের ফলাফল হিসাবে তৈরি করে। এমনকি একটি নিবন্ধে যা ফেয়ারফোন ভক্তরা পড়তে পারে, এটি একটি চিত্তাকর্ষক অভ্যর্থনা, বিশেষত যেহেতু জেনারেল 6 প্লাস স্পেসিফিকেশনগুলিতে বড় ব্র্যান্ডগুলিকে কঠোরভাবে চাপ দিচ্ছে না। 649 ডলারে, আপনি আরও শক্তিশালী হার্ডওয়্যার সহ প্রচুর অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ফোন খুঁজে পেতে পারেন এবং নিয়মিত ফেয়ারফোনে 6 জেনারেটরের তুলনায় আপগ্রেডগুলি নাটকীয় নয়। আপনি যা প্রদান করছেন তা হ'ল একটি ফোন যা প্রতিস্থাপনের পরিবর্তে রাখা এবং মেরামত করার জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এছাড়াও, জেনার 6 প্লাস মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে ফেয়ারফোনের পূর্ববর্তী বাধাগুলির মধ্যে একটি সরিয়ে দেয়, যা সরাসরি গুগলের সাধারণ অ্যাপ্লিকেশন এবং পরিষেবাগুলির সাথে কোম্পানির দ্বারা বিক্রি করা হয়। পিছনে তাকিয়ে, কী পছন্দ করা যায় না?পোলের অপ্রতিরোধ্য ফলাফল সত্ত্বেও, আমাদের পূর্ববর্তী নিবন্ধের মন্তব্য বিভাগে কয়েকটি সংরক্ষণ ছিল। পাঠক ডুগলহেড মেরামতযোগ্য ধারণাটি পছন্দ করেছিলেন তবে অনুপস্থিত হেডফোন জ্যাককে একটি চুক্তি ব্রেকার বলে অভিহিত করেছিলেন, চ্যাংহাইট্রাভিস সম্মত হয়েছিলেন যে যদি এটিতে কেবলমাত্র একটি 3.5 মিমি হেডফোন জ্যাক এবং এফএম রে
bangla_paragraph5: একটি সুষম দৃষ্টিভঙ্গির জন্য, সিকিউর ওপেনসোর্স সরাসরি অভিজ্ঞতা থেকে এসেছিল, বলেছিল, আমি ফেয়ারফোনের ধারণাটি পছন্দ করি, আমি এই মন্তব্যটি প্রেরণের জন্য একটি ব্যবহার করছি, তবে মনে করি না যে জেনার 6 হার্ডওয়্যারটি আবার প্রিমিয়াম প্রদানের পক্ষে যথেষ্ট দীর্ঘস্থায়ী সমস্যাগুলি সমাধান করেছে।

title: Meta fixes distressingly obvious smart glasses recording LED loophole
title_bn: মেটা ফিক্সগুলি LED ফাঁক রেকর্ডিংয়ের জন্য উদ্বেগজনকভাবে সুস্পষ্ট স্মার্ট গ্লাসগুলি
author: TechPulse
excerpt: You won't believe how easy it was to bypass Meta privacy protections.
paragraph1: C. Scott Brown / Android AuthorityTL;DR Meta’s smart glasses attempt to detect when their recording LED is blocked or tampered with, and will refuse to start filming. It turns out this check was only performed when recordings were initiated, and users could just start filming and cover the LED afterwards. Meta is currently rolling out a fix to correct this behavior.
paragraph2: Retro gamers may remember the old PlayStation 1 swap trick: The system would only check disc integrity when first booting, so you could run imports or backups by first powering the PlayStation up with a legit disc in it, and then quickly swapping it out. It turns out that Meta’s smart glasses have been vulnerable to a similar attack, and the company is only just now getting around to patching it.Everybody’s concerned about smart glasses and privacy right now, and probably the biggest issue there is centered on surreptitious recording. Even though we all carry around phones capable of sneakily recording videos, some folks are just really upset about the idea that someone could film them with smart glasses, and they’d never know it.
paragraph3: Responding to that pressure, manufacturers like Meta have been building their glasses with conspicuous recording LEDs, broadcasting to anyone nearby that they’re actively recording.Immediately, there’s been pushback from users, with some even taking steps to block or physically disable such LEDs, resulting in a bit of an arms race with manufacturers attempting to detect such measures.Remember our PlayStation 1 swap trick? As it turns out, apparently Meta glasses would only check whether their LED was blocked when users first started recording.
paragraph4: And just like Sony pirates who would swap in that CD-R a moment later, owners could block the LED after initiating the recording, without any problems.Alas, Meta is now onto them. VP of wearables Alex Himmel shares on Threads that an update closing this loophole is currently rolling out to devices (via Engadget).That said, the fight against users trying to circumvent such protections is almost certainly far from over, and Himmel acknowledges that future updates will likely be needed to keep the company’s privacy protections working as intended.

bangla_paragraph1: সি স্কট ব্রাউন / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষটিএল;ডিআর মেটা এর স্মার্ট গ্লাসগুলি যখন তাদের রেকর্ডিং এলইডি ব্লক বা ছলনা করা হয় তখন সনাক্ত করার চেষ্টা করে এবং চিত্রগ্রহণ শুরু করতে অস্বীকার করবে। দেখা যাচ্ছে যে এই চেকটি কেবলমাত্র রেকর্ডগুলি শুরু হওয়ার পরে করা হয়েছিল এবং ব্যবহারকারীরা কেবলমাত্র চিত্রগ্রহণ এবং LED কে পরে coverেকে রাখতে পারে। মেটা বর্তমানে এই আচরণটি সংশোধন করার জন্য একটি ফিক্স চালু করছে।
bangla_paragraph2: রেট্রো গেমাররা পুরানো প্লেস্টেশন 1 সুইপ ট্রিক মনে রাখতে পারেঃ সিস্টেমটি কেবল প্রথম বুট করার সময় ডিস্কের অখণ্ডতা পরীক্ষা করবে, যাতে আপনি প্রথমে প্লেস্টেশনের সাথে একটি বৈধ ডিস্ক দিয়ে চালিত করে আমদানি বা ব্যাকআপ চালাতে পারেন এবং তারপরে দ্রুত এটিকে স্যুইচ করে। দেখা যাচ্ছে যে মেটা এর স্মার্ট গ্লাসগুলি অনুরূপ আক্রমণের জন্য ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ ছিল এবং সংস্থাটি কেবলমাত্র এখনই এটি প্যাচ করার দিকে এগিয়ে যাচ্ছে। প্রত্যেকে স্মার্ট চশমা এবং গোপনীয়তা সম্পর্কে এখনই উদ্বিগ্ন, এবং সম্ভবত সেখানে সবচেয়ে বড় সমস্যা
bangla_paragraph3: এই চাপের প্রতিক্রিয়া হিসাবে, মেটা এর মতো নির্মাতারা তাদের চশমাগুলি দৃশ্যমান রেকর্ডিং এলইডি দিয়ে তৈরি করছে, কাছাকাছি যে কাউকে সম্প্রচার করছে যে তারা সক্রিয়ভাবে রেকর্ড করছে। অবিলম্বে, ব্যবহারকারীদের কাছ থেকে চাপ এসেছে, এমনকি কিছু লোক এই জাতীয় এলইডগুলি ব্লক বা শারীরিকভাবে নিষ্ক্রিয় করার পদক্ষেপ নিয়েছে, যার ফলে নির্মাতাগুলির সাথে অস্ত্রের দৌড়ের কিছুটা পরিমাণে এই ধরনের ব্যবস্থা সনাক্ত করার চেষ্টা করছে। আমাদের প্লেস্টেশন 1 সুইপ কৌশলটি মনে রাখবেন? যেমনটি দেখা যাচ্ছে, মেটার চশমার কেবলমাত্র তাদের এলইই চেক করবে কিনা?
bangla_paragraph4: এবং ঠিক যেমন সনির জলদস্যুরা সিডি-আর-এর সাথে এক মুহুর্ত পরে স্যুইচ করে, মালিকরা কোনও সমস্যা ছাড়াই রেকর্ডিং শুরু করার পরে এলইডি ব্লক করতে পারে। দুর্ভাগ্যক্রমে, মেটা এখন তাদের উপর রয়েছে। পোশাকের ভিপি অ্যালেক্স হিমেল থ্রেডসে শেয়ার করেছেন যে এই ফাঁকটি বন্ধ করার একটি আপডেট বর্তমানে ডিভাইসে চালু হচ্ছে (এঙ্গ্যাজেটের মাধ্যমে) । এটি বলেছে, এই ধরনের সুরক্ষা এড়ানোর চেষ্টা করে ব্যবহারকারীদের বিরুদ্ধে লড়াই প্রায় অবশ্যই শেষ হতে দূরে, এবং হিমিল স্বীকার করে যে ভবিষ্যতে আপডেটের প্রয়োজন হতে পারে
bangla_paragraph5: আমাদের সম্প্রদায়ের অংশ হওয়ার জন্য আপনাকে ধন্যবাদ। পোস্ট করার আগে আমাদের মন্তব্য নীতি পড়ুন।

title: This duck-shaped robot is almost cute enough to make you forget its AI
title_bn: এই হাঁসের আকৃতির রোবটটি প্রায় এতটাই মিষ্টি যে আপনি এর এআই ভুলে যাবেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Eat your heart out Boston Dynamics.
paragraph1: TL;DR Hugging Face has unveiled a $400 bipedal robot called Microduck. The duck-shaped robot features 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects. Microduck comes with learned behaviors and can be controlled with a gamepad, but developers can also teach it new skills through reinforcement learning, simulation, and open-source software. AI has earned an overwhelmingly negative perception over the last couple of years. At this point, is there any way for the technology to shed that stigma and become more approachable to the general public?
paragraph2: One of the best attempts at that may be Hugging Face’s new tiny duck-like robot.Hugging Face has unveiled a cute bipedal robot known as Microduck. The robot is about 10 inches tall and features 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two inertial measurement units (IMU), and an articulated beak that can pick up objects. According to the company, the duck character was born as a result of the robot’s proportions, beak, and waddling gait.It can perform a variety of actions and behaviors out of the box, like walking, sitting, crouching, and even skating.
paragraph3: You can also control Microduck with a gamepad, have it follow a laser dot, and let it interact with its surroundings. Hugging Face says that it wanted to create a product that anyone could start using right away.However, Microduck doubles as a development platform, allowing developers to take things even further. It features an open-source software stack so you can teach it new skills and behaviors through reinforcement learning, simulation, or programming new code. The main Microduck repository is available starting today, and the Microduck RL contains the reinforcement learning and simulation tools.
paragraph4: Microduck happens to be the second robot the company has launched. The first was Reachy Mini, a desktop set robot meant to be a platform for building conversational AI, experimenting with vision models, and creating human-robot interactions. Unlike Reachy Mini, Hugging Face says Microduck was designed not to be taken too seriously. As an extension of this sentiment, Microduck is available in more colors than Reachy Mini.Microduck is available for pre-order starting today for $399 on the company’s website.
paragraph5: You’ll be able to choose from four colorways: Cream, Graphite, Lavender, and Sky. If you live in North America, the UK, or Europe, the first deliveries are expected to arrive before this Christmas.FollowThank you for being part of our community. Read our Comment Policy before posting.
bangla_paragraph1: টিএল;ডিআর হ্যাগিং ফেস মাইক্রোডাক নামে একটি ৪০০ ডলারের দ্বিপদ রোবট উন্মোচন করেছে। এই হাঁসের আকারে রোবটে ১৫ টি মোটর, একটি ক্যামেরা, একটি গভীরতা সেন্সর এবং একটি জোটযুক্ত ডিক রয়েছে যা বস্তুগুলি তুলতে পারে। মাইক্রডাক শিখে নেওয়া আচরণ সহ আসে এবং একটি গেমপ্যাড দিয়ে নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা যায়, তবে বিকাশকারীরা এটিকে শক্তিশালীকরণ শেখার, সিমুলেশন এবং ওপেন-সোর্স সফ্টওয়্যারগুলির মাধ্যমে নতুন দক্ষতাও শিখতে পারে । গত কয়েক বছরে এআই একটি অপরিসীম নেতিবাচক উপলব্ধি অর্জন করেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই ক্ষেত্রে সবচেয়ে ভাল প্রচেষ্টা হ'ল হ্যাগিং ফেসের নতুন ক্ষুদ্র হাঁসের মতো রোবট। হ্যাগिंग ফেস মাইক্রোডাক নামে পরিচিত একটি মিষ্টি দ্বিপাদ রোবটের উন্মোচন করেছে। রোবোটটি প্রায় 10 ইঞ্চি লম্বা এবং এতে 15 টি মোটর, একটি ক্যামেরা, একটি গভীরতা সেন্সর, দুটি ইনার্শিয়াল পরিমাপ ইউনিট (আইএমইউ) এবং একটি জমজ ডক রয়েছে যা বস্তুগুলি তুলতে পারে। সংস্থা অনুসারে, হাঁসের চরিত্রটি রোবটেটের অনুপাত, ডক এবং হাঁটাচলা এর ফলস্বরূপ জন্মগ্রহণ করেছে। এটি বাক্সের বাইরে বিভিন্ন ক্রিয়াকলাপ এবং আচরণ সম্পাদন করতে পারে।
bangla_paragraph3: আপনি একটি গেমপ্যাড দিয়ে মাইক্রোডাক নিয়ন্ত্রণ করতে পারেন, এটিকে একটি লেজার ডট অনুসরণ করতে পারেন এবং এটিকে তার চারপাশের সাথে ইন্টারঅ্যাক্ট করতে দিন। হ্যাগিং ফেস বলেছে যে এটি এমন একটি পণ্য তৈরি করতে চেয়েছিল যা যে কেউ অবিলম্বে ব্যবহার শুরু করতে পারে। যাইহোক, মাইক্রডাক একটি বিকাশ প্ল্যাটফর্ম হিসাবে দ্বিগুণ হয়, যা বিকাশকারীদের আরও এগিয়ে যাওয়ার অনুমতি দেয়। এটিতে একটি ওপেন সোর্স সফ্টওয়্যার স্ট্যাক রয়েছে যাতে আপনি এটিকে শক্তিশালী শেখার, সিমুলেশন বা নতুন কোড প্রোগ্রামিংয়ের মাধ্যমে নতুন দক্ষতা এবং আচরণ শিখতে পারেন। প্রধান মাইক্রোক রিপোজিটরি
bangla_paragraph4: মাইক্রোডাক হল দ্বিতীয় রোবট যা কোম্পানি চালু করেছে। প্রথমটি ছিল রিচি মিনি, একটি ডেস্কটপ সেট রোবোট যা কথোপকথন AI তৈরির, দৃষ্টি মডেলগুলির সাথে পরীক্ষা-নিরীক্ষা এবং মানব-রোবট মিথস্ক্রিয়া তৈরির জন্য একটি প্ল্যাটফর্ম হতে পারে। রিচি মিনির বিপরীতে, হ্যাগিং ফেস বলেছে যে মাইক্রোককে খুব গুরুত্বের সাথে নেওয়া হয়নি। এই অনুভূতির একটি এক্সটেনশন হিসাবে, মাইক্রডাক রিচি মিনিটির চেয়ে আরও রঙে পাওয়া যায়। মাইক্রোদাকটি আজ থেকে $ 399 এর জন্য প্রাক-অর্ডার করার জন্য উপলব্ধ।
bangla_paragraph5: আপনি চারটি রঙের মধ্যে থেকে বেছে নিতে পারবেনঃ ক্রিম, গ্রাফাইট, ল্যাভেন্ডার এবং স্কাই। আপনি যদি উত্তর আমেরিকা, যুক্তরাজ্য বা ইউরোপে থাকেন, তবে এই ক্রিসমাসের আগে প্রথম ডেলিভারি আসবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। অনুসরণ করুনআমাদের সম্প্রদায়ের অংশ হওয়ার জন্য আপনাকে ধন্যবাদ। পোস্ট করার আগে আমাদের মন্তব্য নীতি পড়ুন।

title: Visible is bundling your phone and fiber, because two bills are one too many
title_bn: দৃশ্যমান হচ্ছে আপনার ফোন এবং ফাইবারের সাথে একত্রিত করা, কারণ দুইটি বিল একটার বেশি
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Mobile plan and fiber together for $55/month.
paragraph1: TL;DR Visible One bundles mobile and fiber internet on a single bill, starting at $55/month for 300Mbps fiber and Visible’s standard mobile plan. Visible+ Pro One costs $75/month and upgrades you to 1Gbps fiber plus Visible’s premium mobile plan with 5G Ultra Wideband and a smartwatch line. There are no added taxes, fees, contracts, or credit checks, but the bundles are limited to homes that already have an inactive Fios ONT installed. Soon after debuting its 5G home internet option, Verizon MVNO Visible is now introducing a new bundle that combines its mobile services and fiber home internet.Aptly named Visible One, the new bundle is offered through Visible Fiber, with the company leaning heavily into its no-hidden-fees, no-annual-contracts, and no-credit-check approach to attract price-conscious consumers.
paragraph2: Getting your home internet and mobile plan from a single carrier isn’t all that new. What makes Visible’s approach unique is its combination of mobile service and Verizon Fios-based fiber service under a single Visible-branded plan and under a single bill, essentially eliminating the need to opt for and manage two different plans.VerizonVisible One comes with the MVNO’s base mobile plan, which includes unlimited 5G and 4G data on Verizon’s network, unlimited nationwide talk and text, unlimited calling and messaging to Mexico and Canada, and more.On the home internet side, you get a 300Mbps fiber connection with internet equipment included. Visible One costs $55/month, but new customers can currently get the plan for $50/month for the first two months ($100 upfront payment required).
paragraph3: For users who might want a bit more, the MVNO also has a second bundle. It includes the carrier’s Visible+ Pro plan with unlimited data on Verizon’s 5G Ultra Wideband network, alongside a 1Gbps fiber connection for the home. Visible+ Pro One costs $75/month. There’s no introductory offer for the premium plan.That’s all you really pay for the plans.
paragraph4: There are no added taxes or fees, no annual contracts, and no activation or router fees. The only catch here is that the bundles aren’t available to all. You cannot get the bundles unless your home already has an inactive Optical Network Terminal (ONT) installed. There are no technicians involved here to run new fiber lines — you will have to activate the service yourself using the existing ONT.Check out Visible’s home internet eligibility checker to see what plans are available to you.
